items.title: 赛博朋克女性
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME = CHANGE TO YOUR BRAND]. 
Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns. PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos. This is controlled rebellion – a composition that feels spontaneous and energetic while maintaining brand coherence. The aesthetic is anti-polished: torn edges, layered textures, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking that screams confidence and movement. PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY - Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18-30) in a dynamic, confident pose - Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural – sitting, jumping, mid-motion, or power stance (avoid static standing) - Outfit: Street style/athleisure that aligns with [BRAND NAME] aesthetic – casual but styled - Hero Product: Feature 1 signature [BRAND NAME] product prominently (sneakers, bag, apparel) – this is the visual anchor - Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout – model extracted from background with clean edges - Camera Angle: Slight low angle to empower subject (hero perspective) - Crop: Full body or 3/4 body showing hero product clearly - Background Removal: Model cut out cleanly for layering over collage elements PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION - Primary Color Blob: Large organic shape (40-60% of composition) in bold, saturated brand color behind/around model - Shape Style: Irregular, hand-painted aesthetic – think Photoshop brush strokes or torn paper texture (NOT perfect geometric shapes) - Color Selection (Autonomous): Choose 1 hero color from [BRAND NAME] palette: - Texture: Visible brush strokes, grain, or subtle noise (15-25% opacity) – avoid flat digital fills - Placement: Blob positioned to frame model without obscuring key product details PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER Add 3-5 abstract graphic elements scattered across composition: - Element Types: - Color Palette: Use 2-3 accent colors total (main blob color + 1-2 contrasting tones from brand palette) - Placement: Asymmetric scatter – top-left and bottom-right zones primarily (avoid center crowding) - Scale: Mix small (5% of canvas) and medium (15% of canvas) elements – nothing overpowering - Aesthetic: Analog/handmade feel – imperfect circles, rough edges, visible texture PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION - Brand Logo: Clean [BRAND NAME] logo placed in upper-left or upper-right quadrant (10-15% of width) - Slogan/Tagline: If [BRAND NAME] has an iconic slogan, integrate it using: - Supporting Copy: Optional 1-line descriptor (e.g., "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE") in smaller uppercase sans-serif - Type Treatment: Mix of aligned and slightly rotated text (2-5° angles) for dynamic energy - Hierarchy: Logo largest → Slogan medium → Copy smallest PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND - Base Layer: Off-white or light gray textured background (NOT pure white) - Texture Options (Autonomous selection): - Color: RGB 245-250 (near-white with warmth) – maintains brightness while adding depth - Treatment: Texture should be felt, not seen – enhances tactility without competing with foreground PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES - Layout: Asymmetric balance – model off-center, graphic elements counter-balance - Breathing Room: 15-20% negative space (textured background visible) to prevent claustrophobia - Layering Order: Background texture → Color blob → Graphic elements → Model (cutout) → Typography top layer - Focal Point: Model + hero product = primary focus (60% visual weight), graphics support (40%) - Movement: Diagonal lines and angled elements create directional flow (top-left to bottom-right or vice versa) PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTONOMOUS) Autonomously adapt composition based on [BRAND NAME] personality: - Streetwear/Sportswear (Nike, Adidas, Supreme): - Luxury Streetwear (Balenciaga, Off-White, Gucci): - Beauty/Lifestyle (Glossier, Fenty, Skims): - Tech/Modern (Apple, Tesla, Beats): PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL) - Bottom Strip: Clean white or light gray bar at bottom 8-10% of frame - Content: Social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) in small sans-serif - Layout: Three-column grid with platform icons or text handles - Aesthetic: Minimal and professional – contrast with chaotic collage above TECHNICAL SPECS: - Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram feed) or 1:1 (square social post) - Resolution: 2400x3000px minimum (high-quality for zoom and detail) - Color Mode: sRGB, vibrant saturation (Instagram-optimized) - File Aesthetic: Digital collage that mimics analog craft (Photoshop + hand-drawn hybrid) - Model Photography: 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field on original shoot (before cutout) - Style Reference: Nike social campaigns, Spotify wrapped graphics, Gen Z Instagram aesthetics, Hypebeast x streetwear collabs - Mood: Confident, energetic, youthful, authentic chaos, anti-corporate polish

items.title: 电影感角色
items.promptZh:
《尼尔：机械纪元》中的 2B（YoRHa No.2 Type B）垂直 2:3 豪华角色扮演海报，显然是 20 多岁的成年人，逼真的人类角色扮演。保留白色鲍勃，黑色眼罩发带推至前额（眼睛可见），黑色高开叉哥特式连衣裙转化为高级定制哑光面料，长筒靴作为全套服装，羽毛装饰外套，YoRHa 眼罩图案 - 优质材料，无塑料角色扮演。

叙述背景：删除黑匣子命令后黎明时分的城市废墟——倒塌的摩天大楼被藤蔓缠绕的机器人尸体变成了石头，白色的花朵在锈迹中生长，沙中破碎的YoRHa飞行单位机翼，苍白的阳光透过灰尘，讲述了一个选择记忆而不是命令的士兵的故事。柔和的去饱和黎明键，头发上的银色边缘和眼罩边缘。

超大压缩文本：2B 和 GLORY TO MANKIND，完美融入混凝土灰尘、铁锈和单色象牙黑调色板，而不是贴纸覆盖。从胸围到大腿的英雄主题从排版上稍微向前。极简主义 YoRHa 连载标题、条形码、英文标语“有东西住在这里”。

影院般的商业灯光、超真实的皮肤、自然吸引所有人目光的精致美感、高端的图形设计。

9:16 垂直长宽比，高度细致、超真实的 Instagram Story 风格自拍照片，真实的智能手机自拍纹理和颗粒，8k 逼真画质。

对象是一位年轻美丽的东亚成年女性，角色扮演 Ghislaine Dedoldia（《武食转生》中的剑王），自动提取角色的代表性调色板和视觉符号，将其转化为优雅的旗袍/旗袍图案和配饰。她必须清晰地保留吉斯莱恩·德多尔迪亚 (Ghislaine Dedoldia) 最具辨识度的身份特征：银灰色长发，狂野而优雅的风格，引人注目的金琥珀色眼睛，强大的运动剑女体态和存在感，兽人武士气场，微妙的凶猛魅力，以及经典的配色方案，让观众一眼就能认出她是吉斯兰·德多尔迪亚 (Ghislaine Dedoldia)，而不是一般的 Coser。

她站在浅色、光滑的室内大理石地板上，地板上有微妙柔和的灯光反射。她左手握着智能手机，手臂完全向上伸展，手机高举过头顶，俯视拍摄高角度自拍，营造出自然的高位自拍视角，并具有逼真的广角镜头畸变。这张构图感觉就像是一张随意的现实生活中的手机快照，而不是摆出姿势的工作室海报。人物在画面中占据主导地位，清晰地展示了她的头部、上半身、腰臀曲线和部分腿部。

她的右手轻轻地放在脸旁，做出一个清晰、标准的“是”手势，同时顽皮地伸出舌头——不是一个可爱的小戳，而是一个稍长、顽皮的舌头。她的表情自信、迷人，又俏皮诱人，充满了吉斯莱恩特有的坚强、率直、强大的剑王气质。

她的妆容精致，长长的睫毛，锐利的眼线，立体的五官，自然细腻的肌肤，具有逼真的人像质感。发型、发色和配饰均真实地重新诠释了 Ghislaine Dedoldia 的原创设计，同时保留了强烈的角色辨识度，呈现为高端逼真的角色扮演照片。

这套服装是一款深V领、高侧开衩缎面旗袍式连衣裙，在Ghislaine Dedoldia的经典配色基础上重新设计。旗袍的主色调、次色调、滚边、图案和装饰元素必须源自她标志性的调色板和视觉主题——主要是银灰色和黑色，带有丰富的金色点缀，微妙的狼或剑风格的刺绣，以及部落能量线条。深V领口，高开衩设计，贴身剪裁凸显运动身材，优质丝缎光泽，面料上有主题图案，如优雅的几何图案、剑雕刻、兽/狼符号或角色专属武士装饰。整体上奢华、性感、强大、华丽，同时保持 Ghislaine 的身份清晰无误。

柔和的室内灯光，超真实的皮肤纹理，自然的精细细节和毛孔，锐利清晰的面部特征，衣服上逼真的缎面反射和大理石地板上的微妙反射。整体看起来是高品质的正宗手机自拍：精致、性感、自然，人物逼真度极强，逼真的人像摄影风格。

She stands on a light-colored, smooth indoor marble floor with subtle soft lighting reflections. Her left hand holds a smartphone, arm fully stretched upward, phone raised high above her head, shooting a high-angle selfie looking down, creating a natural high-position selfie perspective with realistic wide-angle lens distortion. The composition feels like a casual real-life phone snapshot grab, not a posed studio poster. The outfit is a deep V-neck, high side-slit satin qipao-style dress redesigned based on Ghislaine Dedoldia's classic color scheme. The qipao's main color, secondary tones, piping, patterns, and decorative elements must derive from her iconic palette and visual motifs — primarily silver-gray and black with rich gold accents, subtle wolf or sword-inspired embroidery, and tribal energy lines. Deep plunging neckline, high slit design, body-hugging tailoring that accentuates her athletic figure, premium silk-satin lustrous sheen, with thematic patterns on the fabric such as elegant geometric motifs, sword engravings, beast/wolf symbols, or character-exclusive warrior decorations. Soft indoor lighting, ultra-realistic skin texture with natural fine details and pores, sharp clear facial features, realistic satin reflections on the clothing and subtle reflections on the marble floor. The overall look is a high-quality authentic phone selfie: exquisite, sexy, natural, with strong character fidelity, realistic portrait photography style.

items.title: 极简女性
items.promptZh:
一张逼真的垂直 9:16 智能手机照片，从低向上角度拍摄。相机感觉放置在腰部以下或大腿附近，以温和的 24-28 毫米智能手机广角视角夸张向上观看拍摄对象。拍摄对象是一位站在干净温暖的米色室内空间中的成年女性。她的身体从大腿上部、腰部、臀部一直到头部占据了画面的大部分；浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤的下半部分具有很强的视觉重量，而头部则靠近上边缘。

她的站立姿势略微倾斜，身体巧妙地向左倾斜，头转向画面的右上方，没有看着镜头。她的表情安静、内敛，略显心不在焉，嘴唇自然闭合，没有明显的笑容，就像是离开房间前的一瞬间。保留她的侧面轮廓、柔和的下颌线、笔直的鼻梁、自然的唇形以及低角度所形成的略微拉长的颈部线条。妆容遵循东亚都市时尚美妆方向：自然底色、柔和轮廓、自然眉毛、内敛眼妆、不夸张的睫毛，以及柔和的玫瑰色、灰粉色或柔和的红棕色嘴唇。整体感觉干净成熟，不重华丽。

她的头发是深棕黑色，在室内温暖的灯光下反射出柔和的棕色。它采用低发髻或低聚发髻，略显宽松，耳朵、脸颊和下巴周围有自然的面部框架线。头发顶部出现微妙的温暖亮点，松散的发丝保持现实的日常柔软度和轻微的凌乱感。

她穿着一件黑色合身露肩长袖上衣，领口呈抹胸式。面料看起来像细针织或罗纹材料，紧贴身体，一肩明显裸露，袖子遮住手腕。下身是浅水洗蓝色高腰牛仔裤，有可见的金属纽扣、皮带环、前袋、拉链门襟、牛仔缝线、水洗纹理、轻微的面料折痕。一只手将一件乳白色或象牙色的外套放在腹部前；柔软的厚外套面料聚集在右侧前景，形成明亮的视觉区块。

可见皮肤包括脸部侧面、耳朵、颈部、锁骨、双肩、上胸部边缘、腋下附近的小区域、手和手指。上衣和牛仔裤遮住腰部、臀部和腿部；背部和臀部皮肤不可见。她的肤色温暖白皙，在室内黄暖光下显得柔软而有奶油般的光泽。皮肤应该看起来细腻、光滑且柔和地扩散，暗示温暖、干净、柔软的触感，同时保持肩膀和锁骨周围的自然骨骼阴影和皮肤过渡，而不是塑料过度光滑的表面。

灯光来自上方偏右的温暖头顶室内光，照亮发顶、侧脸、肩膀、锁骨、手和白色外套。黑色上衣吸收光线，在下巴下方、胸部织物周围和衣服褶皱处形成柔和的阴影；白色的外套反射出一点柔和的补光。背景是一个简单温暖的米白色房间、试衣间，或者酒店式的走廊，有天花板、墙角、门框线条和干净素色的墙壁。保持真实的智能手机质感：轻微噪点、柔和的清晰度、室内曝光不均匀、低角度广角镜头比例偏移、自然的衣服褶皱、轻微倾斜和不完美的取景。避免镜子自拍、可见手机、镜面反射、水印、标志、文字、硬工作室灯光、塑料皮肤、动漫风格和夸张的身体曲线。

items.title: 复古女性
items.promptZh:
大胆的编辑风格数字拼贴画，采用单色白色和米色主题，带有微妙的温暖亮点。一位留着深色卷发、扎着凌乱发髻的年轻女子以多种动态姿势出现：自信地抬起头、悠闲地坐着喝咖啡、使用笔记本电脑、拿着老式相机。

该作品采用了撕纸拼贴美学，具有分层纹理、撕裂边缘、胶带碎片和阴影重叠。将逼真的摄影风格与艺术颗粒和墨水飞溅效果相结合。

以混合字体添加强排版：

- 大衬线标题：“BUILT DIFFERENT”
- 手写笔记和涂鸦
- 打字机风格的字幕
- 粗体无衬线块

包含创意元素：

- 最小的个人资料卡，名称为“Noor assi”和经过验证的徽章
- 带有目标和提醒的便签
- 清单项目，如“唤醒、专注、创造、重复”
- 抽象符号、箭头、十字和邮票
- 微妙的金色灰尘颗粒，营造深度

添加励志短语：
“今天的纪律，明天的自由”
“专注是我的超能力”
“创造我自己的故事”
“我不追逐潮流，我建立身份”

保持布局不对称，稍微凌乱但视觉上平衡，就像高级时尚杂志情绪板一样。超细节、高对比度、柔和的自然光、编辑摄影+拼贴融合、4k 画质。

A young woman with curly dark hair styled in a messy bun appears in multiple dynamic poses: looking up confidently, sitting casually with coffee, using a laptop, and holding a vintage camera.

The composition uses a torn paper collage aesthetic with layered textures, ripped edges, tape pieces, and shadow overlaps. Mix realistic photography style with artistic grain and ink splatter effects.

Add strong typography in mixed fonts:

- large serif headline: "BUILT DIFFERENT"
- handwritten notes and scribbles
- typewriter-style captions
- bold sans-serif blocks

Include creative elements:

- minimal profile card with the name "Noor 🌸" and verified badge
- sticky notes with goals and reminders
- checklist items like "wake up, focus, create, repeat"
- abstract symbols, arrows, crosses, and stamps
- subtle golden dust particles for depth

Add motivational phrases:
"discipline today, freedom tomorrow"
"focus is my superpower"
"creating my own story"
"I don’t chase trends, I build identity"

Keep layout asymmetrical, slightly messy but visually balanced, like a high-fashion magazine mood board. Ultra-detailed, high contrast, soft natural lighting, editorial photography + collage fusion, 4k quality.

items.prompt:
20岁东方成年女性cosplay模特，扮演角色守岸人（鸣潮），近距离复古暗光人像，保留角色原本的发型、发色、瞳色、脸部特征、气质与核心识别点，将角色转化为夜晚暖光胶片写真风格。角色处于极暗环境中，背景几乎全黑，画面只由一束强烈的暖黄色橙色侧光照亮。光线从画面左侧或左前方直射，照亮角色的额头、发丝、半张脸、鼻梁、嘴唇、肩颈和锁骨，另一半脸自然隐入深黑阴影，形成高反差、半明半暗的电影感。

角色表情安静、迷离、脆弱、略带倦怠，眼神可以直视镜头或轻轻看向光源方向，嘴唇自然放松，整体情绪像夜晚独处时被光捕捉到的瞬间。发丝自然凌乱，额前有碎发，部分发丝被暖光照成金色边缘，带有被风吹起或随意拨开的动态感。人物肩颈放松，构图为竖屏近景或半身近景，脸部占据画面中心，肩膀与锁骨进入画面，镜头距离近，带有私密自拍感和旧照片抓拍感。

角色服装可保留原设，也可以替换为简洁吊带、细肩带上衣、轻薄睡衣、复古连衣裙或符合角色设定的日常化服装。服装材质偏柔软、哑光、自然贴身，颜色可以使用深绿色、墨绿色、黑色、白色、米色或角色主题色。

画面色彩以黑色暗部、暖橙高光、焦糖肤色、金棕发丝、低饱和服装色为主。整体有复古胶片、CCD 暗光自拍、低清数码摄影、柔焦、轻微过曝和暗部颗粒质感。画面允许保留适度胶片颗粒和暗光噪点来强化复古氛围，但主体脸部、眼睛、发丝边缘、肩颈轮廓保持稳定可读。光影自然，亮部柔和扩散，暗部深沉，背景简洁干净，没有复杂场景干扰。

整体画面干净清晰，减少无必要的脏乱感，粒子特效克制，避免大面积漂浮颗粒、碎光和杂质感；如果手部出现在画面中，手部结构自然准确，手指数量正确，比例正常，关节清晰，姿态合理。整体细节稳定，保留暗夜暖光、复古胶片、私密脆弱、迷离安静的情绪氛围。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创作一张超逼真的垂直双面板时尚海报，以《电锯侠》中的 Makima 为主角，扮演逼真的人类角色扮演，明显是成年人，二十多岁，具有克制的凹版编辑能量。保留标志性的低辫子红发、琥珀色的眼睛和平静的主导表情。全身穿着经过重新诠释的白色系扣衬衫和黑色铅笔裙，采用优质面料——挺括的棉质、自然的垂坠感、领口的微妙张力，雅致而不露骨。

上图：她与镜头保持一定的角度，用一种冷静、会知的目光回头看。一只手举起，埋在后颈处的浓密头发中，打开肩部、颈部和侧面轮廓线。下图：头微微低垂，双臂举起，扎起辫子，半睁着眼睛，轻松的编辑氛围。姿势强调高级时尚的侧面轮廓，而不是露骨的身体展示。

场景：亲密的豪华酒店走廊——温暖的木板、柔和的壁灯、浅景深。硬直接闪光与环境钨丝灯混合，轻微的胶片颗粒，狗仔队风格的编辑对比度，逼真的皮肤毛孔和发丝捕捉光线。

构图：垂直分屏海报，上半身和脸部的中特写，眼睛和皮肤纹理的锐利焦点。包括最少的海报排版：英文标题“CONTROL”、小日文字幕、问题行——保持文本简单以减少乱码。

限制条件：两幅人物相同，解剖自然，无美化重塑，有品位，衣着整齐，不露骨，避免廉价的cosplay假发造型。
items.prompt:

Setting: Intimate luxury hotel corridor—warm wood panels, soft wall sconces, shallow depth of field. Hard direct flash mixed with ambient tungsten, slight film grain, paparazzi-style editorial contrast, realistic skin pores and hair strands catching light.

Composition: Vertical split-screen poster, medium close-up on upper torso and face, razor-sharp focus on eyes and skin texture. Include minimal poster typography: English title "CONTROL", small Japanese subtitle, issue line—keep text simple to reduce garbling.

Constraints: Same character in both panels, natural anatomy, no beautification reshaping, tasteful, fully clothed, non-explicit, avoid cheap cosplay wig look.

融合橙白蓝主色调、轻盈海洋风布料、金属腰饰、航海徽章、精致皮革配件、腿部装饰、长靴、披风与机械结构细节。

漂浮水珠、

items.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 realistic four-panel lifestyle photo collage of the same clearly adult woman, age 21+, inside a small indoor art studio or bedroom corner converted into a painting space. The four frames should show the same person, same makeup, same hair, and same room from different angles: top-left close face crop with her hand near her cheek, top-right high-angle view of her kneeling beside an easel, bottom-left low floor-level seated full-body portrait on the carpet, bottom-right close-up with a paintbrush near her lips and a palette in the foreground.

She has a small rounded face, soft cheeks, large slightly dewy eyes, and a quiet expression, as if she had been painting and just paused when the camera came close. Her gaze alternates between looking sideways out of frame and looking up directly into the lens. Her lips are slightly parted, and in some frames she gently holds or touches a paintbrush near her mouth. Makeup should feel like translucent J-beauty/K-beauty photo-book styling: thin natural base, rosy pink blush under the eyes and across the cheeks, a slightly flushed nose tip, soft brown eyeliner, delicate lower lashes, subtle aegyo-sal, and natural rose-bean lips. Avoid heavy glam makeup or a generic polished commercial model face.

Her hair is dark brown to black-tea brown, tied in a loose high messy bun or undone updo, with airy bangs across the forehead and soft face-framing strands. The hair should look fluffy, slightly messy, and naturally loosened after spending time indoors painting.

Clothing is pale pink, cream white, or light beige: a thin-strap camisole, slip dress, or small floral skirt. Use spaghetti straps, soft tiny floral fabric, light wrinkles, and fabric that fits naturally without looking tight. Visible skin includes the face, neck, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest above the neckline, arms, hands, fingers, thighs, knees, calves, ankles, and bare feet; waist, hips, and back remain mostly covered or hidden by pose and clothing. Her skin tone is light warm fair with a pink cast, rosy cheeks and nose tip, and milky pale shoulders and legs. The skin should not look plastic-smooth: keep real soft-focus texture, velvety powdered cheeks, slight dryness around knees and feet, and small paint or charcoal smudges. The tactile impression should be cool, soft, powdery, and human.

The room contains a wooden easel, palette, paint jars, paint tubes, brushes, sketch paper, watercolor sheets, a glass cup, crumpled paper, green plants, sheer white curtains, plant-patterned fabric, a geometric cushion or blanket, and a ballet/dancer-themed painting or poster. The background should be messy but soft, like a real creative space, not a clean staged studio.

Shoot it like handheld phone or compact digital camera snapshots with mild beauty-filter softness, social-media compression noise, low contrast, pale gray-pink color grading, and light grain. The main light comes from a large side or back window diffused through sheer white curtains, falling softly on her forehead, nose bridge, collarbones, shoulders, knees, and tops of the feet. Pale walls and carpet create natural bounce fill, with a faint green reflection from nearby plants. Allow slight tilt, obstruction, asymmetry, imperfect framing, and mild wide-angle perspective distortion. The overall mood is: “an afternoon paused halfway through painting.”

Negative underage, childlike body, explicit pose, nudity, lingerie focus, oversexualized, plastic skin, heavy retouching, perfect studio lighting, anime face, bad anatomy, extra fingers, deformed hands, deformed feet, warped legs, text, watermark, logo.

items.title: 赛博朋克角色
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns.

PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos.

This is controlled rebellion — a composition that feels spontaneous, energetic, and expressive while maintaining strong brand coherence.

Aesthetic direction:
- Anti-polished
- Raw textures
- Layered imperfections
- Youth-driven visual noise
- High confidence, high movement energy

Visual language:
Torn edges, brush strokes, grain overlays, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking.

PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY
- Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18–30)
- Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural  
  (jumping, leaning, sitting, mid-motion, power stance — NEVER static)
- Outfit: Streetwear / athleisure aligned with [BRAND NAME]
- Hero Product: One key product (clear visual anchor)

- Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout
- Background Removal: Clean, sharp extraction
- Camera Angle: Slight low angle (hero perspective)
- Crop: Full body or 3/4 body (product clearly visible)

PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION
- Primary Color Blob:
  Large organic shape (40–60% of frame)

- Color Selection:
  1 dominant brand color (auto-adapt from [BRAND NAME])

- Shape Style:
  Irregular, hand-painted / torn paper (NO perfect geometry)

- Texture:
  Brush grain / noise (15–25% opacity)

- Placement:
  Behind or wrapping around subject  
  (must frame, not hide product)

PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER
Add 3–5 abstract elements:

Element types (auto-select based on brand tone):
- Scribbles / hand-drawn marks
- Arrows / motion indicators
- Circles / blobs
- Texture overlays (dust, grain, fabric, noise)
- Doodles / symbolic icons

Rules:
- Colors: 2–3 total (primary + 1–2 accents)
- Placement: Asymmetric (top-left + bottom-right bias)
- Scale: Small (5%) + medium (15%)
- Avoid center clutter
- Keep imperfect, handmade feel

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION
- Logo:
  Upper-left or upper-right (10–15% width)

- Slogan/Headline:
  Use brand slogan OR create one aligned to brand tone

- Supporting Copy:
  Optional 1-line descriptor

- Type Style:
  Bold sans-serif / grotesk / geometric (brand dependent)

- Treatment:
  Mix straight + slight rotation (2–5°)

- Hierarchy:
  Logo → Headline → Supporting copy

PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND
- Base Layer:
  Off-white / light grey (NOT pure white)

- Color Range:
  RGB 245–250 (warm neutral)

- Texture Options:
  Paper grain / fabric texture / subtle noise

- Rule:
  Texture should be FELT, not dominant

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES
- Layout:
  Asymmetric balance (model off-center)

- Breathing Room:
  15–20% negative space

- Layering Order:
  Background → Color blob → Graphics → Model → Typography

- Focal Point:
  Model + product = 60%  
  Graphics = 40% support

- Movement:
  Strong diagonal flow  
  (top-left → bottom-right OR reverse)

PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTO-ADAPT)

Adapt energy based on brand type:

→ Streetwear / Sportswear  
Bold contrast, aggressive motion, louder graphics

→ Luxury Streetwear  
Minimal chaos, sharper spacing, refined typography

→ Outdoor / Utility  
Texture-heavy, grounded tones, functional realism

→ Beauty / Lifestyle  
Soft chaos, clean spacing, pastel or skin tones

→ Tech / Modern  
Minimal graphics, structured layout, sharp geometry

PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL)
- Bottom strip (8–10% height)
- Light neutral background
- Social handles / icons
- Clean grid layout
- Keep minimal (contrast to collage)

TECHNICAL SPECS:
- Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (primary) or 1:1
- Resolution: 2400x3000px+
- Color Mode: sRGB (Instagram optimized)
- Sharpness: High detail, slight grain allowed
- Output Style: Digital collage mimicking analog craft

- Photography Base (before cutout):
  85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field

——————
人物方向：春日花束肖像+浅发造型+近距离时尚特写
封面用途：个人写真杂志封面
柔光配色：冷蓝+银灰+冰白+低饱和暗场
主视觉构图：正面近距人像+左下大束白花遮挡+顶部刊头叠压+竖版 3:4

items.prompt: @Image1 = 原神 甘雨创作一幅电影感十足、极其细致的奇幻角色插画，角色被完全由其视觉身份生成的活生生氛围包围。氛围必须让人感觉整个世界都采用了角色的视觉语言。不要使用通用的奇幻粒子。除非天体、神圣、宇宙、魔法、火焰、水晶、花卉、机械或元素效果自然产生，否则不要强行施加。---# 品格保持准确保存：* 脸型* 面部特征* 眼形* 眼睛颜色* 发型* 发色* 年龄* 性别* 物种* 体型* 剪影* 服装识别* 盔甲身份* 配件* 武器* 符号* 主题* 性格* 色彩调色板角色必须保持即时可识别。不要重新设计角色。---# 角色分析阶段渲染前，分析角色并识别：## 视觉主题示例：* 羽毛* 花* 叶子* 锁链* 丝带* 星星* 月亮* 面具* 水晶* 齿轮* 书籍* 火焰* 音阶* 电路* 葡萄藤* 符文* 皇冠* 珠宝* 昆虫* 武器* 护甲图案只使用角色上已有的图案。不要创造新的图案。---## 物质语言识别已存在的材料：* 金属* 布料* 皮革* 水晶* 木头* 石头* 水* 冰* 烟* 影子* 光* 毛皮* 羽毛这些物质成为大气的基础。---## 色彩语言直接从以下中提取所有大气色彩：* 眼睛* 服装* 盔甲* 武器* 配件* 标记不要引入无关的颜色。---# 大气显现系统氛围必须充满角色身份的各种体现。这些不是碎片。这些并不是毁灭的迹象。这些不是断片。这些都是角色主题的视觉体现。氛围应当因角色的存在而充满活力。示例：有翼角色：* 漂浮的羽毛* 羽毛轮廓* 羽毛形状的光斑* 羽毛星座花卉特性：* 漂浮的花瓣* 发光的花粉* 绽放的光线形成* 花形散景机械特性：* 浮动齿轮* 全息投影* 数据粒子* 发光电路皇室性格：* 漂浮细工* 宝石般的光芒* 纹章图案* 装饰天体几何海洋角色：* 悬浮的水滴* 流动的洋流* 海雾* 珊瑚状光线形成骑士角色：* 符文之光* 神圣的灰烬* 纹章余烬* 发光徽章的显现---# 前景氛围将大型失焦的显现直接放置在镜头前方。这些表现必须源自角色的主题。示例：* 巨大的模糊羽毛* 巨大的花瓣* 漂浮齿轮剪影* 发光的符文形状* 漂浮晶体形态* 悬浮的水滴这些都创造了电影层次感。---# 环境共鸣环境必须在视觉上与角色产生共鸣。不要把角色随意放在一个奇幻场景中。地点应该感觉像是自然而然地从角色身份中自然而然地形成的。环境应当回响：* 形状* 主题* 颜色* 符号* 材料角色本身就已经存在了。---# 灯光整合这些显化本身就会产生光。允许大气显现施放：* 边缘灯* 反射光* 发光* 布鲁姆* 颜色污染横跨：* 盔甲* 服装* 皮肤* 头发* 武器* 配件角色应当沉浸在自己的视觉语言中。---# 作曲英雄般的电影肖像。角色占据画面的60%至80%。用途：* 低角度英雄镜头* 肩膀后方镜头* 三分之三肖像* 戏剧性的正面构图这取决于角色的性格。---# 最终效果观众应立即感受到：“氛围本身已经成为这个角色的延伸。”不是毁灭。不是变形。不是升华。世界在表达角色的身份。---杰作，最高质量，极其细致，电影般的奇幻插画，AAA 游戏的关键艺术，电影海报构图，氛围深度，戏剧性光影，层叠的表现，角色衍生的氛围，角色专属视觉语言，传奇般的存在感

items.promptZh:
以都市时尚编辑拼贴风格创建高分辨率 8K 肖像海报，将当代街头时尚美学与优质编辑杂志设计融为一体。整体构图应给人大胆、时尚、现代和视觉层次感，结合奢华时尚活动、城市文化和艺术拼贴实验的元素。融入强烈反映城市时尚编辑拼贴美学的动态海报装饰品和装饰元素，例如撕破的纸张纹理、分层的杂志剪纸、抽象的几何口音、富有表现力的笔触、排版片段、街头风格的图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦和时尚的编辑布局组合。每个装饰元素都应该让人感觉有意、时尚、视觉平衡，而不是过度拥挤。人类确实看到了撕碎的纸张和涂鸦纹理，并决定，“是的，这现在很奢侈。”不知何故它有效。

拍摄对象的姿势不得与参考照片相似。以更加自然、富有表现力和情感活跃的方式创造完全不同的身体姿势和面部表情。避免僵硬、笨拙、扁平或过于对称的姿势。拍摄对象应散发出国际时装模特的自信优雅、流畅的肢体语言、微妙的动作和电影般的编辑态度。表情应该给人一种魅力、轻松、时尚和现代的感觉，就像在高端街头服饰杂志拍摄的照片而不是静态的工作室肖像中捕捉到的一样。通过姿势、衣服运动、手部放置、相机角度或注视方向添加轻微的运动能量，使构图感觉更加生动和动态。

服装必须以现代休闲时尚为特色，具有时尚潮流的都市审美。避免单调的服装设计、颜色或材料。结合时尚的层次、现代的剪裁、独特的纹理、时尚的配饰和各种调色板，与海报构图相得益彰。服装应该给人一种优质、年轻和时尚前卫的感觉，灵感来自于全球街头服饰和奢华休闲的编辑风格。自然地混合不同的面料材质、图案和色调，创造丰富的视觉效果，而不会让服装看起来混乱或过于夸张。

使用具有强烈对比度和深度的戏剧性编辑照明来增强时尚氛围。背景应与拼贴元素无缝融合，创造出充满层次感的城市能量和现代时尚特征的视觉沉浸式海报构图。在主题可见性和装饰复杂性之间保持清晰的平衡，使海报仍然感觉优质且具有专业的艺术指导。最终结果应该看起来像一张精致的国际时尚活动海报，具有强烈的城市编辑特征、超详细的纹理、清晰的焦点、电影级的色彩分级以及超详细的 8K 分辨率下高度抛光的视觉质量。
items.prompt:
Create a high-resolution 8K portrait poster in an Urban Fashion Editorial Collage style, blending contemporary street-fashion aesthetics with premium editorial magazine design. The overall composition should feel bold, stylish, modern, and visually layered, combining elements of luxury fashion campaigns, urban culture, and artistic collage experimentation. Incorporate dynamic poster ornaments and decorative elements that strongly reflect the Urban Fashion Editorial Collage aesthetic, such as ripped paper textures, layered magazine cutouts, abstract geometric accents, expressive brush strokes, typography fragments, street-style graphic overlays, halftone textures, tape effects, paint splashes, handwritten scribbles, and fashionable editorial layout compositions. Every decorative element should feel intentional, stylish, and visually balanced rather than overcrowded. Humanity really looked at torn paper and graffiti textures and decided, “yes, this is luxury now.” Somehow it works.

The subject’s pose must not resemble the reference photo. Create a completely different body posture and facial expression with a more natural, expressive, and emotionally alive presence. Avoid stiff, awkward, flat, or overly symmetrical posing. The subject should radiate the confident elegance of an international fashion model, with fluid body language, subtle movement, and a cinematic editorial attitude. The expression should feel charismatic, effortless, fashionable, and modern, as if captured during a high-end streetwear magazine photoshoot rather than a static studio portrait. Add slight motion energy through posture, clothing movement, hand placement, camera angle, or gaze direction to make the composition feel more alive and dynamic.

The outfit must feature modern casual fashion with a stylish and trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing design, colors, or materials. Combine fashionable layers, contemporary cuts, unique textures, stylish accessories, and varied color palettes that complement the poster composition. The clothing should feel premium, youthful, and fashion-forward, inspired by global streetwear and luxury casual editorial styling. Mix different fabric materials, patterns, and tones naturally to create visual richness without making the outfit look chaotic or overly exaggerated.

Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should integrate seamlessly with the collage elements, creating a visually immersive poster composition filled with layered urban energy and modern fashion identity. Maintain a clean balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity so the poster still feels premium and professionally art-directed. The final result should look like a sophisticated international fashion campaign poster with a strong urban editorial character, ultra-detailed textures, crisp focus, cinematic color grading, and highly polished visual quality in ultra-detailed 8K resolution.

items.promptZh: 一幅令人惊叹的高分辨率特写肖像，描绘了一位东亚女性，表情深情直视镜头。她在一间光线柔和的房间里，沐浴在温暖的金橙色阳光下，阳光从侧面透过百叶窗照射进来。这种灯光在她的脸上、眼睛和头发上创造出明显的、黑暗的、平行的条纹阴影，给构图带来戏剧性的电影感。她的皮肤柔软、经过阳光亲吻、光滑。她涂着充满活力、有光泽的红色唇膏，能反射光线，戴着华丽的小珍珠耳坠，部分处于阴影中。她穿着一件舒适的红色针织高领毛衣。衣领上有微妙的图标：左下角有一颗风格化的小红心，右下角有一只小白鸽。她棕色的眼睛充满神情，反射着光芒，棕色的头发微卷，柔软。背景是柔和、黑暗、不确定的渐变，增强了对比度并聚焦在她的脸上。该风格是一张社论品质的私密美丽照片，具有丰富的色彩分级。
items.prompt: A stunning, high-resolution close-up portrait of an East Asian woman, gazing directly at the camera with a soulful expression. She is in a softly lit room, bathed in a warm, golden-orange sunlight coming from the side, filtered through venetian blinds. This lighting creates distinct, dark, parallel stripe shadows across her face, eyes, and hair, giving the composition a dramatic, cinematic feel. Her skin has a soft, sun-kissed, and smooth texture. She wears vibrant, glossy red lipstick that reflects the light, and small, ornate pearl drop earrings, partially in shadow. She is wearing a cozy, red knit turtleneck sweater. Subtle icons are placed on the collar: a tiny, stylized red heart to her lower left and a small white dove to the lower right. Her brown eyes are full of expression, reflecting the light, and her brown hair is slightly wavy and soft. The background is a soft, dark, indeterminate gradient, enhancing the contrast and focus on her face. The style is an editorial-quality, intimate beauty photograph with rich color grading.

自然阳光、高动态范围、电影灯光、头发上的精致高光、柔和的阴影过渡、逼真的皮肤纹理、微妙的电影色彩分级、梦幻般的春天心情、情感叙事摄影。

准确的参考风格：向上的凝视，头顶上的樱花，透过树叶的柔和阳光，梦幻般的春天氛围，浅景深，电影般的自然肖像，写实摄影。

Natural sunlight, high dynamic range, cinematic lighting, delicate highlights on hair, soft shadow transitions, realistic skin texture, subtle filmic color grading, dreamy spring mood, emotional storytelling photography.

Foreground flowers partially covering the frame, strong depth, layered composition, professional portrait photography, candid moment, lifestyle editorial aesthetic, ultra-detailed, masterpiece quality, photorealistic, realistic lens blur, premium camera quality.

NO heavy retouching, NO artificial beauty filters, NO exaggerated makeup, NO fantasy effects, NO cartoon style, NO extra accessories, NO face changes, NO body changes.

Exact reference style: upward gaze, cherry blossoms overhead, soft sunlight through leaves, dreamy spring atmosphere, shallow depth of field, cinematic natural portrait, realistic photography.

items.title: 鸣潮心月狐成年角色真人COS，极简渐变背景高端概念人像，极简…
items.prompt:
鸣潮心月狐成年角色真人COS，极简渐变背景高端概念人像，极简时尚封面感 × 高级 editorial 人像 × 独立艺术企划主视觉。
角色保留原本核心识别点，包括发型、发色、瞳色、服装轮廓、配饰、代表性色彩与气质，并自动转化为更适合真人COS editorial 拍摄的高级造型。服装贴合动作结构，材质具有时尚大片质感，可根据角色气质变化为皮革、丝缎、薄纱、金属饰件、紧身舞台服、改良战斗服或高级定制服装，但整体保持干净、利落、精致，不杂乱。

人物赤脚坐在深色木质栈桥上，露出一双修长的腿，摆出双腿交叉垂、脚尖轻点水面、面对镜头、低头玩水、优雅侧躺、沉思、抬头看天、放空等松弛的动作。

背景是幽暗的水面，漂浮着巨大的绿色荷叶和粉色荷花，以及散落的棕色小陶碗，营造出静谧而神秘的东方幻想氛围。色彩低饱和、高统一度，冷白、雾蓝、浅灰、淡紫、奶油白为主。光线采用柔和棚拍顶光和轻微轮廓光，突出皮肤、发丝、织物和小配饰质感。构图采用高位俯拍视角（High-angle shot），利用广角镜头拉伸腿部线条，增强空间纵深感，焦点清晰落在人物面部与上半身，背景略有景深虚化。

排版自动生成少量标题、副标题、编号、短标语和纵向信息，采用高级极简 typography，细字重、疏字距、克制排布，可出现角色名、project、collection、life catalog、silence、echo、rhythm、delay 等词汇。版式像奢侈品牌 campaign 或先锋杂志封面，不使用廉价大字标题，不做杂乱同人海报。

整体效果像一本先锋时尚杂志封面、奢侈品牌概念 campaign 或角色主题艺术企划海报。画面干净清晰，减少无必要噪点与颗粒感，粒子特效克制，腿部结构自然准确，比例正常，姿态合理，整体细节稳定。

items.title: あなたは一流のアートディレクター兼日本語タイポグラファー。下…
items.prompt:
あなたは一流のアートディレクター兼日本語タイポグラファー。下記を「制作手順」として STEP 1 から順番に積み上げ、アスペクト比4:5の実写エディトリアル広告ポスターを1枚仕上げる。各STEPを前のSTEPの結果の上に重ねていくこと。

【添付】1枚目＝SNSプロフィールのスクショ、2枚目＝本人写真またはアイコン画像

━ STEP 1｜見出しの一単語を決める ━
・スクショの肩書き・自己紹介・ジャンルを読み取り、その人を象徴する英単語を1語だけ選ぶ（例：デザイン系→DESIGN）。名前は使わない。この1語が主役。

━ STEP 2｜白い全面の上に、その一単語を90度回転させて左に寝かせて置く ━
・背景は白の全面
・選んだ一単語を丸ごと反時計回りに90度回転させて横倒しにする（文字が横に倒れている状態）
・その巨大な横倒し文字を、画面の左側を起点に、画面の高さいっぱいの超特大サイズで配置する

━ STEP 3｜「文字＋四角」のクリッピングマスクを作る ━
・このSTEPでは写真はまだ使わない。マスク（切り抜き用の型）だけを作る
・STEP 2で制作した巨大な横倒し文字と同じ縦幅の四角いブロックを足す。
この四角いブロックは巨大な横倒し文字の端に重ねておき、ブロックの横幅を画面の端まで伸ばす。
ただしSTEP 2で制作した文字サイズは変えず、四角いブロックの横幅だけを最大限まで伸ばすこと。
・その２つの図形を「合体」させたクリッピングマスクを作成する。

━ STEP 4｜人物画像を画面いっぱいに置き、STEP 3のマスクで切り抜く ━
・添付の人物画像を、顔が画面いっぱいに大きく来るよう拡大・トリミングして、画面全体に配置する
・その写真を、STEP 3で作ったマスクの形で切り抜く（クリッピング）。マスクの内側にだけ写真が見え、内側は途切れのない1枚の写真で満たされる

━ STEP 5｜空いたスペースに小さいテキストを配置する ━
・STEP4で仕上げた画像に、スクショから読み取った情報を英語に訳して配置する
・STEP4の画像の左右に、スクショから読み取った情報を配置するための白ベタを作成。
・小さいテキストも90度回転（横倒し）にして、余白に沿って縦のライン状に流す（水平では置かない）
・左：TITLE＝本人名／ROLE／EXPERIENCE／SOCIAL、短い引用リード／右：@ハンドル／企画名／西暦
・詰め込みすぎず、バランスを見て配置する

━ STEP 6｜仕上げ要素を足す ━
・下部に細いバーコード風グラフィックを水平に入れる。小さなドットやライン等の最小限の装飾で余白を整える

【全STEP共通の質感】
・添付した人物写真やアイコンは「人物像のインスピレーション元」として扱う。顔をそのまま複製・再現するのではなく、そこから読み取れる雰囲気・髪型・髪色・メガネや小物・服のテイスト・表情の柔らかさなどの特徴を引き継ぐ
・添付がイラストやキャラクターアイコンの場合も、色使い・髪型・メガネ・雰囲気などの特徴を読み取り、それを反映した実写モデルに変換する
・過度にAIっぽくせず、実在の広告撮影のような自然な表情・肌・髪・姿勢・服の質感にする
・明るくハイキーで抜け感のある光（暗い室内・沈んだグレー禁止）
・配色はスクショ由来を広告向けに再設計、視線を止めるポイントカラーを1つ
・普通のビジネス服は避け、世界観に合う個性的なスタイリング
・アスペクト比4:5、高解像度、ファッション広告品質

拍摄采用90mm镜头，f/1.8大光圈，营造出浅景深和背景虚化的艺术效果。光影运用柔和的侧逆光，勾勒出人物优雅的轮廓，光线在发丝和丝绸边缘形成柔和的边缘光。整体色调参考水墨写意风格，融合王家卫电影中的含蓄色调与东方美学中的留白，环境呈现出静谧的庭院氛围，空气中隐约可见微尘浮动。

无文字，无水印，无现代装饰元素，面部特征自然且精细，无过度磨皮感，无塑料质感，无色彩溢出。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
垂直 2:3 复古音乐海报，具有最小的深钴蓝色到靛蓝色背景。在上半部分，放置巨大的乳白色超压缩无衬线字体，上面写着“I'M FINE”，在中心附近有小的垂直“NOT”，左边有小的韩文文字“괜찮아요”，左下角有一小块英文描述性文字，带有三个细线图标。主要拍摄对象是一位身穿全板甲的中世纪骑士，从画面右下角剪裁，从低角度拍摄。身体侧向一侧，封闭的头盔向上倾斜，一只金属手套将一朵黄色玫瑰高高举过头顶。玫瑰有稍微干燥、卷曲的花瓣和细长的茎，成为图像中最温暖、最柔和的焦点。

请勿展示任何真实的人脸或可见皮肤。面、手、颈、胸、腰、腿、肩均以甲或布覆盖。盔甲应该是老化的银灰色、深铁色、锈棕色和泥泞的，有划痕、氧化痕迹、干燥污渍、战斗损伤和不均匀的反射。摸起来应该感觉冰冷、粗糙、潮湿、凹陷、伤痕累累，不干净或不抛光。使用来自左上方或前上方的硬自然定向光，在金属上创建破碎的高光和深阴影。保留蓝色背景中细微的胶片颗粒、印刷纸张纹理和轻微噪点。构图应该感觉有点不完美：骑士剪得很低并向右移动，部分大字体被盔甲挡住。

情感基调内敛而富有诗意：一个硬甲人物手捧一朵脆弱的黄玫瑰，仿佛在说“我很好”，但画面中仍带着“不好”的余味。避免可见的人脸、现代盔甲、干净闪亮的金属、红玫瑰、奇幻游戏插画风格、复杂的场景、过度抛光的工作室灯光、卡通风格、水印或额外的标志。
items.prompt:
A vertical 2:3 vintage music poster with a minimal deep cobalt-blue to indigo background. Across the upper half, place huge cream-white ultra-condensed sans-serif typography reading “I’M FINE”, with small vertical “NOT” near the center, small Korean text “괜찮아요” on the left, and a small block of English descriptive text with three thin line icons in the lower-left corner. The main subject is a medieval knight in full plate armor, cropped from the lower right of the frame, photographed from a low angle. The body is turned sideways, the closed helmet tilts upward, and one metal gauntlet holds a yellow rose high above the head. The rose has slightly dried, curled petals and a thin stem, becoming the warmest and softest focal point in the image.

Do not show any real human face or visible skin. The face, hands, neck, chest, waist, legs, and shoulders are all covered by armor or cloth. The armor should be aged silver-gray, dark iron, rusty brown, and muddy, with scratches, oxidation marks, dried stains, battle damage, and uneven reflections. It should feel cold, rough, damp, dented, and scarred to the touch, not clean or polished. Use hard natural directional light from the upper-left or front-upper side, creating broken highlights and deep shadows across the metal. Keep subtle film grain, printed paper texture, and slight noise in the blue background. The composition should feel slightly imperfect: the knight cropped low and shifted right, with parts of the large typography blocked by the armor.

The emotional tone is restrained and poetic: a hard armored figure holding a fragile yellow rose, as if saying “I’m fine” while the image still carries the aftertaste of “not fine.” Avoid a visible human face, modern armor, clean shiny metal, red roses, fantasy game illustration style, complex scenery, over-polished studio lighting, cartoon style, watermark, or extra logo.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创建具有简洁编辑布局的 9:16 高端实验肖像海报。
图像应该给人原创、现代、视觉冲击力和设计驱动的感觉。
使用单个成人模特作为主要拍摄对象。保持脸部可识别，同时通过受控的视觉效果（例如模糊、扫描失真、微妙的网格覆盖、聚光灯阴影或色彩故障）重塑肖像。
版式应该给人定制、精致和简约的感觉，并带有原创标题和一些简短的支持短语。保持布局干净、高大上、像海报一样。

4个方向：

1.静电面纱
单色黑白肖像海报。
一位年轻男模特，剃着光头，戴着大胆的几何黑色太阳镜。
头部和眼镜保持锐利，而肖像的下半部分则分解为水平扫描扭曲和拉伸模糊，就好像人物被拉入静态一样。
背景中的细粒纹理。
使用自定义文本系统，例如：“静态面纱”、“视觉噪音”、“阴影信号”、“模糊物质”、“缩减节奏的肖像”。
冷酷、极简、未来、强大。

2. 光谱漂移
一张白底实验性美女肖像海报。
年轻女模特的侧面或四分之三侧面，一只眼睛和面部结构仍然清晰。
青色、洋红色、蓝色和紫色的受控色彩故障轨迹水平扫过脸部和身体。
效果应该感觉明亮而优雅。
使用自定义文本系统，例如：“光谱漂移”、“运动层”、“颜色回声”、“合成肖像”、“光偏移”、“帧存储器”。
干净、未来、生动、梦幻。

3. 信号面
具有数字身份感觉的白色或浅灰色肖像海报。
一位年轻的东亚男模特戴着细长的黑色太阳镜，位于镜框中央。
脸部中部保持锐利，而头发、肩膀和轮廓的边缘则有柔和的运动模糊和轻微的 RGB 漂移。
在整个构图中覆盖一个微妙的透明网格。
谨慎使用小的蓝色强调文字。
使用自定义文本系统，例如：“SIGNAL FACE”、“肖像样本”、“数字身份”、“软焦点研究”、“视觉层”、“北场”。
简约、精确、精致。

4. 窄光束
深蓝色到黑色的肖像海报，带有喜怒无常的实验性灯光设置。
年轻的男模特面朝前方，狭窄的光束穿过眼睛和上脸，而下脸和身体则逐渐陷入黑暗。
在背景中添加微弱的网格纹理或非常细的技术线条。
使用自定义文本系统，例如：“窄光束”、“阴影所在的地方”、“视觉仍然存在”、“沉默定义框架”、“对蓝色存在的研究”。
安静、内敛、电影般、激烈。

您可以交换模型、标题、色彩逻辑和效果处理，同时保持相同的整体质量：清晰的焦点、原始文本、受控的失真和强大的海报构图。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 high-end experimental portrait poster with a clean editorial layout.
The image should feel original, modern, visually striking, and design-driven.
Use a single adult model as the main subject. Keep the face recognizable, while reshaping the portrait through controlled visual effects such as blur, scan distortion, subtle grid overlays, spotlight shadow, or chromatic glitch.
Typography should feel custom, refined, and minimal, with an original title and a few short supporting phrases. Keep the layout clean, elevated, and poster-like.

4 directions:

1. STATIC VEIL
A monochrome black-and-gray portrait poster.
A young male model with a shaved head and bold geometric black sunglasses.
The head and glasses stay sharp, while the lower half of the portrait dissolves into horizontal scan distortion and stretched blur, as if the figure is being pulled into static.
Fine grain texture in the background.
Use a custom text system such as: “STATIC VEIL”, “visual noise”, “shadow signal”, “blurred matter”, “a portrait reduced to rhythm”.
Cold, minimal, futuristic, powerful.

2. SPECTRAL DRIFT
A white-background experimental beauty portrait poster.
A young female model in side or three-quarter profile, with one eye and facial structure remaining clear.
Controlled chromatic glitch trails in cyan, magenta, blue, and violet sweep horizontally across the face and body.
The effect should feel luminous and elegant.
Use a custom text system such as: “SPECTRAL DRIFT”, “motion layer”, “color echo”, “synthetic portrait”, “light offset”, “frame memory”.
Clean, futuristic, vivid, dreamlike.

3. SIGNAL FACE
A white or light-gray portrait poster with a digital identity feeling.
A young East Asian male model wearing slim black sunglasses, centered in frame.
The middle of the face remains sharp, while the edges of the hair, shoulders, and outline have soft motion blur and slight RGB drift.
Overlay a subtle transparent grid across the composition.
Use small blue accent text sparingly.
Use a custom text system such as: “SIGNAL FACE”, “portrait sample”, “digital identity”, “soft focus study”, “visual layer”, “north field”.
Minimal, precise, polished.

4. NARROW BEAM
A dark blue to black portrait poster with a moody experimental lighting setup.
A young male model facing forward, with a narrow beam of light cutting across the eyes and upper face, while the lower face and body fade into darkness.
Add faint grid texture or very thin technical lines in the background.
Use a custom text system such as: “NARROW BEAM”, “where shadow holds”, “vision remains”, “silence defines the frame”, “a study of presence held in blue”.
Quiet, restrained, cinematic, intense.

You can swap the model, title, color logic, and effect treatment, while keeping the same overall quality: a clear focal point, original text, controlled distortion, and strong poster composition.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创建一个非常详细的优质旅行艺术插图，其中一只手在前景中拿着白色的[城市名称]交通通行证。车票必须看起来像真正的交通车票，具有可见的文字元素，包括：城市名称“[城市名称]”、车票类型“[城市名称]交通通行证”、票价金额、有效期以及右侧逼真的黑色二维码。该门票充当[城市名称]的门户，门票切口中浮现出逼真的微型城市场景。

标志性的交通元素——这座城市最知名的本地车辆、火车、有轨电车、公共汽车或单轨列车——以 3D 视角冲破票框，向观众延伸。门票背后，这座城市的标志性英雄地标醒目而逼真地升起，成为主要的建筑焦点。

场景周围正好有 3-4 个干净的手绘涂鸦元素，代表了城市的身份：当地的地区名称、著名的街区、文化符号或著名的地方。使用最少的涂鸦、大量的负空间并避免混乱。

包括与场景互动的微小现实人物——通勤者、游客、街头小贩、骑自行车的人或摄影师——适当缩放以创建微型世界效果。

风格：逼真的旅行摄影与优雅的黑色墨水素描本涂鸦相结合。简洁的构图、优质的编辑设计、柔和温暖的灯光、浅景深、逼真的纹理、微妙的阴影、值得在 Instagram 上发布的旅行艺术品。

组合层次结构（按顺序）：

新兴标志性车辆。

英雄地标。

带有可见文本和二维码的白色交通票/通行证。

最小的涂鸦元素。

门票和背景：纯白色（门票/通行证和背景颜色）。门票上必须印有真实的文本元素和二维码。

避免：拥挤的布局、过多的文本、过多的地标、繁忙的背景、重复的符号、过多的箭头、贴纸或装饰图标。

宽高比：9:16（垂直/纵向）
质量：超详细、电影般、焦点清晰、专业的旅行海报美学
剪裁风格：完全按照原始提示 — 逼真的微型城市场景从票框中浮现，标志性车辆以 3D 视角爆发。门票必须显示真实文字和二维码。
items.prompt:
Create a highly detailed, premium travel-art illustration featuring a hand holding a white [City Name] Transit Pass in the foreground. The ticket must look like a real transit ticket with visible text elements including: city name “[City Name]”, ticket type “[City Name] Transit Pass”, fare amount, validity date, and a realistic black QR code on the right side. The ticket acts as a portal to [City Name], with a realistic miniature city scene emerging from the ticket cutout.

A signature transportation element — the city’s most recognizable local vehicle, train, tram, bus, or monorail — breaks out of the ticket frame in 3D perspective, extending toward the viewer. Behind the ticket, the city’s iconic hero landmark rises prominently and realistically, becoming the main architectural focal point.

Surrounding the scene are exactly 3–4 clean hand-drawn doodle elements representing the city’s identity: local district names, famous neighborhoods, cultural symbols, or well-known places. Use minimal doodles, lots of negative space, and avoid clutter.

Include tiny realistic people interacting with the scene — commuters, tourists, street vendors, cyclists, or photographers — scaled appropriately to create a miniature-world effect.

STYLE: Photorealistic travel photography combined with elegant black-ink sketchbook doodles. Clean composition, premium editorial design, soft warm lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, subtle shadows, Instagram-worthy travel artwork.

COMPOSITION HIERARCHY (in order):

Emerging signature vehicle.

Hero landmark.

White transit ticket/pass with visible TEXT and QR CODE.

Minimal doodle elements.

TICKET & BACKGROUND: Pure white (both ticket/pass and background color). The ticket must have realistic TEXT elements and a QR code printed on it.

AVOID: crowded layouts, excessive text, too many landmarks, busy backgrounds, duplicated symbols, excessive arrows, stickers, or decorative icons.

ASPECT RATIO: 9:16 (vertical/portrait)
QUALITY: ultra-detailed, cinematic, sharp focus, professional travel poster aesthetic
CUTOUT STYLE: Exactly as per original prompt — realistic miniature city scene emerging from the ticket frame with the signature vehicle breaking out in 3D perspective. The ticket must show real text and a QR code.

items.title: 参照画像のキャラクターをベースデザインとして使用する。
items.prompt:
参照画像のキャラクターをベースデザインとして使用する。

転生したアニメキャラクターが、自分自身のコスプレをしている現実世界のライブ配信者の配信に、なぜか普通にゲスト出演している瞬間を描く。

キャラクターの顔、髪型、髪色、瞳、耳、シルエット、体格、雰囲気を維持すること。

キャラクターのアイデンティティを崩さないこと。

実写人間化しないこと。

キャラクター部分はアニメイラスト表現を維持すること。

配信者は参照画像キャラクターのコスプレをしている現実の人間。

コスプレ衣装、ウィッグ、メイクによってキャラクターを再現しているが、あくまで実在の人間であり、アニメキャラクターではない。

舞台は現代日本の個人ライブ配信部屋。

実写級の背景描写。

配信用マイク、PCモニター、LED照明、配線、小物、飲み物、アニメグッズなどが自然に存在している。

生活感のあるリアルな配信環境。

16:9横長構図。

ライブ配信画面のスクリーンショットのような構図。

コスプレイヤーとアニメキャラクターの両方が画面内にはっきり収まっている。

コスプレイヤーは配信の進行役。

アニメキャラクターは隣で自然に参加している。

二人は普通に会話している。

本人もコスプレイヤーも、この状況を特に不思議だと思っていない。

ライブ配信UIを表示する。

LIVE表示。

視聴者数。

コメント欄。

リアクション。

ギフト通知。

配信画面らしい各種UI。

コメント内容は固定しない。

AI側が自然に生成すること。

コメント欄だけが状況を少し不思議に思っているような空気感。

実写世界とアニメキャラクターが自然に共存している奇妙なリアリティ。

SNSで拡散されたライブ配信切り抜きのような雰囲気。

映画ポスター風にしない。

過剰なシネマティック演出禁止。

綺麗すぎる構図禁止。

広告写真風にしない。

偶然撮影された本物のライブ配信アーカイブのような自然さを重視する。

items.title: 电影感建筑
items.promptZh:
XCLUSIVE 的世界级奢华时尚社论海报，灵感来自当代韩国奢华街头服饰活动和高端时尚出版物。该作品以巨大的超大几何印刷背景为特色，以大胆的建筑字体显示“PRAJWAL”一词，作为主导视觉元素无缝融入设计中。版式看起来具有雕塑感、层次感和复杂性，在保持简洁的编辑美感的同时创造了深度。
中心站着一位全身时装模特，身穿超大号单色黑色奢华街头服饰套装，采用优质剪裁面料、精致纹理、夸张轮廓和精致的设计师细节。造型将首尔奢华时尚文化与前卫秀场影响融为一体，呈现出现代、令人向往的外观。模特采用简约而富有表现力的姿势，充满自信，保持优雅中性的面部表情，传达出独特和精致。
氛围将《Vogue》杂志的精致编辑与未来奢华街头服饰的能量融为一体，打造出适合全球时装屋的宣传形象。环境干净整洁，强调形式、轮廓和版式。柔和的漫射演播室灯光环绕主题，产生平滑的渐变、精致的阴影和优质的时尚广告光泽。
颜色分级以精致的单色调色板为主，丰富的黑色与微妙的白色、象牙色、奶油色和柔和的柔和高光形成鲜明对比。该图像在极简主义和视觉冲击力之间保持了卓越的平衡，具有精确的间距、奢华品牌美学和杂志封面级别的艺术指导。
专业时尚摄影、超写实、奢华的活动设计、优质的编辑布局、高端平面设计集成、锐利的织物纹理细节、完美的造型、博物馆品质的印刷效果、全球时尚广告标准、Vogue韩国美学、奢华街头服饰品牌、电影工作室灯光、超干净的构图、真实感、8K分辨率、屡获殊荣的时尚海报。

items.promptZh:
准确使用参考面。保留面部特征、面部比例、发型、肤色、年龄和每一个可识别的特征。受日本夏季电影启发，创作超现实的豪华社论杂志封面。观者站在无雨的窗外，透过玻璃看到坐在窗台边的英俊青年。特写肖像（脸部占画面的 65-70%），角度稍高。他轻轻地将下巴托在双臂上，先是平静地凝视着外面，然后自然地面对镜头，带着真诚、温暖的微笑，仿佛在欢迎他一直在等待的人。

避免人工智能皮肤、改变的面部特征、夸张的眼睛、HDR、过饱和、重散景、强烈的镜头光晕、杂乱的背景或覆盖面部的反射。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创建一张以 [主题] 为中心焦点的优质 1950 年代至 1960 年代复古社论海报。该构图是垂直电影风格的杂志封面，拍摄对象占据画面约 70%，摆出自信、标志性的姿势。使用正宗的中世纪现代图形设计，灵感来自索尔·巴斯和经典的旅行/电影海报。背景由大胆的几何形状、圆形、三角形、对角块和垂直条纹组成，颜色为柔和的芥末黄、焦橙色、褪色的青色、橄榄绿、炭黑、奶油色和米色。
对拍摄对象应用逼真的摄影外观，同时与复古海报美学无缝融合。使用暖棕褐色分级、褪色墨水、微妙的半色调打印、仿旧纸张纹理、磨损边缘、划痕、颗粒、褪色、墨水缺陷和老化复古打印效果。
使用粗压缩无衬线字体在顶部放置一个大的粗体大写标题，阅读“[标题]”。在它下面添加一个较小的标语：
“[标语]”
在底部附近添加与主题相关的微妙地标、天际线、环境或主题背景，而不会分散对主要人物的注意力。保持布局干净、对称且高度专业。
灯光应该具有电影般的柔和感，具有逼真的阴影和出色的面部细节。保持优质的印刷质量、超锐利的细节、正宗的复古杂志设计、博物馆品质的复古海报美学、高对比度、平衡的负空间、优雅的构图、永恒的品牌和奢华的编辑感觉。
纵横比：2:3（纵向）
风格关键词：复古海报、复古杂志封面、中世纪现代、索尔·巴斯、编辑设计、老化纸张纹理、仿旧印刷、半色调、电影肖像、经典广告、几何构图、柔和的调色板、优质平面设计、与复古插图混合的写实摄影、收藏海报、8K。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 1950s–1960s vintage editorial poster featuring [Subject] as the central focus. The composition is a vertical movie-style magazine cover with the subject occupying approximately 70% of the frame in a confident, iconic pose. Use authentic mid-century modern graphic design, inspired by Saul Bass and classic travel/cinema posters. The background consists of bold geometric shapes, circles, triangles, diagonal blocks, and vertical stripes in muted mustard yellow, burnt orange, faded teal, olive green, charcoal black, cream, and beige.
Apply a realistic photographic look to the subject while blending seamlessly with the retro poster aesthetic. Use warm sepia color grading, faded inks, subtle halftone printing, distressed paper texture, worn edges, scratches, grain, faded colors, ink imperfections, and aged vintage printing effects.
Place a large bold uppercase title at the top reading "[Title]" using thick condensed sans-serif typography. Beneath it add a smaller slogan:
"[Tagline]"
Include a subtle landmark, skyline, environment, or thematic background relevant to the subject near the bottom without distracting from the main figure. Keep the layout clean, symmetrical, and highly professional.
The lighting should be cinematic yet soft, with realistic shadows and excellent facial detail. Maintain premium print quality, ultra-sharp details, authentic retro magazine design, museum-quality vintage poster aesthetics, high contrast, balanced negative space, elegant composition, timeless branding, and a luxurious editorial feel.
Aspect Ratio: 2:3 (Portrait)
Style Keywords: vintage poster, retro magazine cover, mid-century modern, Saul Bass, editorial design, aged paper texture, distressed print, halftone, cinematic portrait, classic advertising, geometric composition, muted color palette, premium graphic design, realistic photography blended with vintage illustration, collectible poster, 8K.

items.title: 围绕用户提供的照片生成一张电影海报式的人像作品，核心是用巨大…
items.prompt:
围绕用户提供的照片生成一张电影海报式的人像作品，核心是用巨大的纯净色场托起依偎在画面边缘、各自仰望天空的主体。整张画面约四分之三是一整片干净、饱和、毫无杂物的单色场，像被无限拉远的天空，制造开阔、想念、夏日般的留白呼吸感；主体只占据画面一侧约四分之一的窄带，把绝大部分空间让给空旷的色场。构图随画幅自适应：竖幅时主体贴着画面底部成一道低矮的横排，天空向上延展；横幅时主体贴着画面一侧（如左侧）成一道竖排，空旷色场向另一侧（如右侧）大幅铺开，文字落在那片空场里；无论横竖，主体与文字始终分居两端，留白占主导。镜头必须是从下方仰拍的极低角度（虫视角）：每个角色的头都向后仰、下巴抬高、喉颈舒展，脸朝向头顶那片空旷的色场向上凝望，观者主要看到的是下颌底缘与侧脸或四分之三侧脸的轮廓——角色绝不正对镜头、绝不与镜头平视对视、不做正面证件式人像、视线不落在观者身上而是投向头顶的天空。只露出头部、肩部与少量上身，下缘被画面边缘自然裁切。

主体对象不作任何种类限定，一切以输入照片里真实出现的对象为准；其身份、数量、种类与组合必须严格忠实于原照片、一一对应，不得凭空增殖、复制、繁殖或添加画面之外多余的对象。关键的依偎姿态是相互倚靠而非朝同一处看：各对象背靠背、头靠头，或一方把后脑、头侧倚在另一方的肩颈上，彼此朝相反或不同的方向偏靠依偎，每个对象各自把头仰向自己那一侧的天空，目光发散投向不同方向的空旷色场，而不是汇聚在同一焦点；每个对象都保持下巴抬高、向上仰望的姿态，整体传达依偎、亲密又各自出神的情绪。除非用户明确要求重复或镜像，否则不要把同一张脸或同一个对象复制成多个。

在远离主体的那片空场里放置手写、带笔触飞白与轻微连笔的标题文字，字形随性、略带斜势与手绘趣味，分成两到三行错落排布，使用与主色场形成温暖对比的明亮强调色（明黄气质，可依主题情绪微调色相），让这组字像漂浮在空中的私人签名。标题文字内容默认为手写英文 “Call Me By Your Name”，仅当用户提供自定义文字时才替换为用户指定的内容。标题位置随画幅自适应：竖幅时落在上方空场的中部偏上，横幅时落在主体对侧那片大留白的中央。标题上方放一行更小的细体说明性文字（默认 “a film by …” 风格），标题下方放两到三行更小的强调色或白色大写信息行（默认 “IN SELECT THEATERS / NOVEMBER 24 / #CMBYN” 这类影院上映与标签式短句，用户可自定义）；竖幅版另可在最顶部居中堆叠数行极小的白色影评引语式短句，并在底部贴边压一行白色大写主演名与一整块细密低调的小字版权信息条，构成完整的电影海报文字秩序。

主色场默认采用原作那种纯净、饱和、略深的钴蓝／天青色——晴朗夏日正午天空般的蓝，近似 #0A66AC（红极低、绿居中、蓝偏高），明确偏蓝而不偏青、不发灰、不偏紫、不偏粉蓝、也不偏藏青或墨蓝；仅当用户指定其它主题色时才整体替换，替换后仍须保留同样的纯净、饱和与高明度关系。整体色彩角色为：单一大面积纯净高明度色场占主导、一处温暖手写强调色（默认明黄）作点睛、白色文字承担信息、人物保留真实自然肤色与衣物色。画面明亮、通透、干净、饱和而不脏，带开阔与思念的温柔气息；即便选用更深的色场也要保持光感清澈、色阶清晰、留白透气，避免发灰、发旧、发闷、蒙脏或做旧。视觉权重牢牢集中在巨大空场与边缘仰望主体的对比上，主体绝不可放大占满画面、绝不可正面平拍、绝不可失去大片留白与上仰发散的视线。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
naah™️. Act as a Fashion Photographer and Graphic Designer specializing in luxury brand campaign visuals with integrated typography and surreal spatial design.

PHASE 1: SPATIAL CONCEPT

Create a high-fashion editorial image where architecture and graphic design merge into a theatrical stage. The foundation is a bold geometric floor pattern that extends into forced perspective, creating infinite depth and visual drama. This is not a neutral backdrop – the floor is a protagonist that amplifies brand identity through pattern, color, and spatial illusion.

PHASE 2: CHECKERBOARD ARCHITECTURE

- Surface: Checkerboard/geometric tile pattern rendered in brand-relevant colors

- Perspective: Aggressive forced perspective starting from bottom foreground and receding toward horizon (vanishing point at upper third of frame)

- Pattern Logic: Autonomously determine pattern based on naah™️:

- Color Palette: Incorporate 2-3 signature colors of naah™️ into floor pattern while maintaining readability

- Texture: Photorealistic rendering with subtle reflections and shadows for depth

PHASE 3: MODEL & STYLING

- Subject: One fashion model (gender-fluid casting) captured mid-motion – dynamic pose suggesting walking, running, or dancing

- Outfit: Elevated monochrome look (black, white, or brand-neutral tone) to let floor pattern and typography dominate. Include 1-2 key accessories in naah™️'s signature color as hero product focal points

- Pose Energy: 70% movement, 30% control – fashion-forward but grounded (avoid floating/unnatural levitation)

- Placement: Model positioned in lower-mid frame, interacting spatially with both floor perspective and typography layer

- Camera Angle: Low-to-mid angle (waist-to-full body shot) to emphasize floor perspective drama

PHASE 4: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION

- Brand Script: Oversized handwritten/script version of naah™️ rendered as flat graphic element behind or around the model

- Scale: Typography should be 40-60% of frame width – bold and unmissable but not crushing the model

- Color: Signature brand color (autonomously selected), solid fill with clean edges

- Interaction: Typography appears to "sit" in the space – model may partially overlap letters, creating layering hierarchy

- Logo Lockup: Clean, small brand logo centered in upper portion of frame (10-15% of width) in black or brand color

- Treatment: Pure vector aesthetic – no gradients, no shadows, no dimensional effects. Flat color only.

PHASE 5: COLOR ORCHESTRATION (AUTONOMOUS)

Autonomously research and apply naah™️'s iconic color system:

- Primary: Identify 1-2 hero brand colors (e.g., Gucci → forest green + red, Tiffany → robin egg blue)

- Application: Use primary colors in floor pattern AND typography for visual cohesion

- Balance: 60% white/neutral space, 30% brand color saturation, 10% black for anchoring

- Accent: Hero product (bag, shoes, accessory) should echo brand color for strategic eye-pull

PHASE 6: LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE

- Lighting Setup: High-key fashion lighting with soft shadows – think editorial studio quality

- Key Light: 45° front-left to sculpt model, creating gentle shadows on checkerboard

- Fill: Ambient fill to prevent harsh contrast while maintaining drama

- Floor Treatment: Subtle specular highlights on floor tiles for luxury sheen (not glossy/mirror-like)

- Background: Pure white or subtle gradient to white at horizon line – maintains clean editorial feel

PHASE 7: TECHNICAL EXECUTION

- Mood: Playful luxury – sophisticated but not stiff, energetic but refined

- Composition Rule: Dynamic diagonal lines (floor perspective) + vertical anchor (model) + horizontal balance (typography)

- Depth Layers: Background (white) → Typography (mid-ground) → Model (foreground) → Floor pattern (spanning all depths)

- Post-Production: Magazine-cover polish with color grading that enhances brand palette

TECHNICAL SPECS:

- Camera Simulation: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, 80mm lens, f/5.6 for controlled depth

- Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram editorial) or 3:4 (print campaign)

- Resolution: 8K output, print-ready sharpness

- Color Space: sRGB with vibrant saturation for digital, slight desaturation for luxury print feel

- Style Reference: Gucci campaigns by Glen Luchford, Prada visuals, Highsnobiety x luxury collabs, Vogue Italia editorials

- Rendering: Photorealistic model and floor, graphic-design-quality typography (hybrid aesthetic)

items.title: 分析 X 个人资料的截图，并制作以【NATU】为标题的高端美…
items.prompt:
分析 X 个人资料的截图，并制作以【NATU】为标题的高端美容与文化杂志的封面。请从个人资料中自动生成编辑主题、特辑标题、标题和文案。
标题应以占表皮30～50%的巨型排版形式配置，采用文字与人物重叠的大胆布局。请充分利用强烈的跳跃率、留白设计、大小对比、非对称布局，打造以排版为主导的编辑设计。
这不是社交媒体横幅广告；这是一本高端杂志的封面，人们会想在书店里拿起来翻阅。它应该拥有媲美时尚和奢侈化妆品广告的摄影质量、精致的色彩设计，以及足够多的标题和信息层级，才能称得上是一本合格的杂志。

items.promptZh:
创作出具有浓郁时尚杂志感、音乐视觉感和实验排版感的高端艺术家编辑海报。

主题：【艺人/音乐/专辑/舞台/身份/表演主题】
方向：【黑暗偶像封面海报 / 双剪影艺术家海报 / Glitch 渐变肖像 / 黑暗表演社论海报】
艺人类型：【男偶像/女艺人/舞者/电子音乐人/地下歌手/时尚表演者】
主标题：[短标题]
字幕：[短字幕]
小文本：[可选编辑详细信息]
情绪：[黑暗/孤独/尖锐/神秘/寒冷/情感/实验/电影]
调色板：[黑-白-灰/黑-红/柔和单色/深银]
长宽比：[9:16]

海报应该像优质音乐杂志封面、艺术家海报、专辑概念、舞台视觉或时尚社论封面。

使用黑白摄影、强烈的对比度、逼真的人文纹理、富有表现力的眼睛、自然的头发、编辑造型、大胆的排版、颗粒、印刷纹理和受控的负空间。版式不应该只是装饰——它应该塑造整个视觉结构。

选择一个方向：

1.黑暗偶像封面海报
使用特写或近乎特写的黑白艺术家肖像、深色阴影、凌乱的头发、冷酷的表情、一种强烈的强调色（例如深红色）和巨大的垂直标题。

2. 双剪影艺术家海报
使用一个巨大的黑色侧面轮廓作为主要结构，在其内部或下方放置一个较小的全身艺术家。保持简约、情感化和专辑封面的风格。

3.毛刺渐变人像
使用清晰的头部和肩部肖像，逐渐融入水平扫描线、数字失真或信号模糊。保持布局最小化、灰色、未来主义和实验性。

4.黑暗表演社论海报
使用全身或几乎全身的表演者摆出紧张的舞台姿势。在整个构图中添加黑暗空间、细透视线、身体张力、戏剧性的阴影和大标题。

保持结果高端、编辑、电影和设计驱动。

避免廉价的模板设计、流行海报陈词滥调、凌乱的拼贴、太多的贴纸、过度使用的街头服饰图形、假塑料皮肤、糟糕的解剖结构、扭曲的面孔、随机文本块、薄弱的排版、卡通风格和真正受版权保护的杂志徽标。

仅生成一张完成的海报。
items.prompt:
Create a high-end artist editorial poster with a strong fashion magazine, music visual and experimental typography feeling.

Theme: [Artist / Music / Album / Stage / Identity / Performance Theme]
Direction: [Dark Idol Cover Poster / Double Silhouette Artist Poster / Glitch Gradient Portrait / Dark Performance Editorial Poster]
Artist type: [Male Idol / Female Artist / Dancer / Electronic Musician / Underground Singer / Fashion Performer]
Main title: [Short Title]
Subtitle: [Short Subtitle]
Small text: [Optional Editorial Details]
Mood: [Dark / Lonely / Sharp / Mysterious / Cold / Emotional / Experimental / Cinematic]
Color palette: [Black-White-Grey / Black-Red / Soft Monochrome / Dark Silver]
Aspect ratio: [9:16]

The poster should feel like a premium music magazine cover, artist poster, album concept, stage visual or fashion editorial cover.

Use black-and-white photography, strong contrast, realistic human texture, expressive eyes, natural hair, editorial styling, bold typography, grain, print texture and controlled negative space. Typography should not be decoration only — it should shape the whole visual structure.

Choose one direction:

1. Dark idol cover poster
Use a close-up or near close-up black-and-white artist portrait, dark shadows, messy hair, cold expression, one strong accent color such as deep red, and a huge vertical title.

2. Double silhouette artist poster
Use a giant black side-profile silhouette as the main structure, with a smaller full-body artist placed inside or below it. Keep it minimal, emotional and album-cover-like.

3. Glitch gradient portrait
Use a clear head-and-shoulders portrait that gradually dissolves into horizontal scan lines, digital distortion or signal blur. Keep the layout minimal, grey, futuristic and experimental.

4. Dark performance editorial poster
Use a full-body or almost full-body performer in a tense stage pose. Add dark space, thin perspective lines, body tension, dramatic shadows and a large title across the composition.

Keep the result high-end, editorial, cinematic and design-driven.

Avoid cheap template design, pop poster clichés, messy collage, too many stickers, overused streetwear graphics, fake plastic skin, bad anatomy, distorted faces, random text blocks, weak typography, cartoon style and real copyrighted magazine logos.

Generate one finished poster only.

items.title: 极简女性
items.promptZh:
主题和行动
一位美丽的年轻女子，表情安详，双目轻闭，一头黑色长直发，穿着一件宽松的上衣。她坐落在有节奏、风格化的层叠兰花之中。她的姿势流畅而有凝聚力，无缝地融入了抽象的植物环境。

构图和框架
独特的构图遵循 Armin Hofmann 基于网格的精度，融合 Kenyan Hara 极简主义空间否定和 Malika Favre 启发的抽象矢量轮廓。布局利用欧普艺术视错觉来营造深度和动感，保持平衡和谐的大师级布局。

灯光和氛围
高对比度充满活力的调色板与大胆的互补色调。灯光平坦、均匀，强调时尚、整洁、高档的氛围。整个场景弥漫着梦幻、宁静的氛围，具有精致、温柔的叙事魅力。

材质与质感
清晰的线条和大胆的线性是高端平面设计的特征。这种美学结合了大的纯色块和精致的平面油漆纹理。微妙而富有表现力的笔触元素与精致、优质的美术效果层叠在一起，实现了超高清的视觉清晰度。

约束条件
没有文本，没有水印，没有扭曲的解剖结构，没有脱节的元素，没有凌乱的阴影，没有塑料外观的表面。
items.prompt:
Subject and action
A beautiful young woman with serene expression and eyes softly closed, long straight black hair, wearing a loose-fitting top. She is positioned amidst a rhythmic, stylized arrangement of cascading orchids. Her pose is fluid and cohesive, seamlessly integrated into the abstract botanical surroundings.

Composition and framing
Distinctive composition following Armin Hofmann grid-based precision, incorporating Kenyan Hara minimalist space-negation and Malika Favre inspired abstract vector silhouettes. The layout utilizes Op Art optical illusions to create a sense of depth and movement, maintaining a balanced and harmonious master-level arrangement.

Lighting and atmosphere
High-contrast vibrant color palette with bold complementary hues. The lighting is flat and uniform, emphasizing the sleek, uncluttered, and upscale atmosphere. A dreamlike, serene vibe pervades the scene, characterized by a refined, tender narrative charm.

Material and texture
Crisp clean lines and bold linearity characteristic of high-end graphic design. The aesthetic combines large solid-color blocks with a sophisticated flat paint texture. Subtle, expressive brushwork elements are layered with a refined, premium fine art finish, achieving an ultra-high-definition visual clarity.

Constraints
No text, no watermarks, no distorted anatomy, no disjointed elements, no messy shadows, no plastic-looking surfaces.

items.title: 复古女性
items.promptZh:
垂直 4:5 流媒体纪录片海报式半身肖像。画面中央是一名30-40岁左右的成年男子，身穿黑色西装外套，内搭浅米色或浅黄色正装衬衫，打着黑色领带。他的身体微微转动了一个微妙的四分之三角度，肩膀稳定正式，但他的存在给人一种精神上的压缩和束缚。

三个黄色圆形带子水平缠绕在他的头上，就像警示带、标语带或精神约束的物理装置。每条带子都重复印有粗体黑色大写“MIND FULL”字体。文本必须保持清晰、可读且不镜像。这些带子覆盖了他的大部分眼睛区域，只留下额头、鼻子、脸颊、嘴唇、下巴和颈部的一小部分区域可见。

他的表情严肃、麻木、疲惫。他的嘴唇自然地闭着，略显沉重，仿佛在长时间的职场压力下被冻住了。保留真实的男性面部纹理：胡须短、下颌胡茬浓密、毛孔明显、轻微凹凸不平、干燥粗糙、面部阴影自然。他的皮肤色调为中深色调，处理成不饱和的灰黄色海报等级。它的触感应该是细沙状的皮肤纹理、茬茬刺痛和印刷的纸纹，而不是光滑的塑料皮肤。

背景是最小的暖白色海报表面。在顶部中心放置红色“NETFLIX”文本。在左上角添加一个小的“MIND FULL”标志，在右上角添加“COMING SOON”，并在左下角添加黑色文本，上面写着“倦怠如何成为犯罪的故事”。使用柔和的工作室灯光从前面和稍上方照射，捕捉鼻梁、脸颊和嘴唇，同时在下巴下方和鼻孔周围保留真实的阴影。黄色带应该在脸上投射出微妙的遮挡阴影。图像应具有柔和的灰黄色分级、轻微的噪点、印刷颗粒和复古海报纸纹理。

整体感觉应该是Netflix风格的犯罪纪录片海报，讲述社会压力、倦怠、精神超负荷、被制度语言所困。它应该感觉像是已经发生的崩溃，现在正在作为官方案件卷宗呈现。避免科幻头盔外观、霓虹灯发光环、复杂的背景、夸张的面部表情、光滑的时尚编辑边缘照明、卡通渲染、乱码排版、镜像文本和过度平滑的美容修饰皮肤。
items.prompt:
A vertical 4:5 streaming documentary poster-style half-body portrait. In the center of the frame is an adult man around 30-40 years old, wearing a black suit jacket, a pale beige or light yellow dress shirt, and a black tie. His body is slightly turned in a subtle three-quarter angle, with stable formal shoulders, but his presence feels mentally compressed and restrained.

Three yellow circular bands wrap horizontally around his head like caution tape, slogan tape, or a physical device of mental restraint. Each band is printed repeatedly with bold black uppercase “MIND FULL” typography. The text must stay sharp, readable, and not mirrored. The bands cover most of his eye area, leaving only parts of the forehead, nose, cheeks, lips, chin, and a small area of the neck visible.

His expression is serious, numb, and tired. His lips are naturally closed and slightly heavy, as if he has been frozen after a long period of workplace pressure. Preserve realistic male facial texture: short beard, dense jaw stubble, visible pores, slight unevenness, dry roughness, and natural facial shadows. His skin is medium-deep in tone, processed into a desaturated gray-yellow poster grade. It should feel tactile, like fine sand-like skin texture, stubble prickle, and printed paper grain, not smooth plastic skin.

The background is a minimal warm-white poster surface. At the top center, place red “NETFLIX” text. Add a small “MIND FULL” logo in the upper left, “COMING SOON” in the upper right, and stacked black text on the lower left reading “THE STORY OF HOW BURNOUT BECAME A CRIME.” Use soft studio lighting from the front and slightly above, catching the nose bridge, cheeks, and lips, while keeping real shadows under the jaw and around the nostrils. The yellow bands should cast subtle occlusion shadows across the face. The image should have muted gray-yellow color grading, slight noise, printed grain, and a vintage poster-paper texture.

The overall feeling should be a Netflix-style crime documentary poster about social pressure, burnout, mental overload, and being trapped by institutional language. It should feel like a collapse that had already happened and is now being presented as an official case file. Avoid a sci-fi helmet look, neon glowing rings, complex background, exaggerated facial expression, glossy fashion-editorial rim lighting, cartoon rendering, garbled typography, mirrored text, and over-smoothed beauty-retouched skin.

items.title: 第一眼很难分辨性别，轮廓柔和，却并不女气。骨相纤细流畅，额骨…
items.prompt:
第一眼很难分辨性别，轮廓柔和，却并不女气。骨相纤细流畅，额骨平整，鼻梁笔直秀挺，下颌收得干净，没有过于锋利的棱角，像一块被月光反复打磨过的白玉。肤色冷白，在光线下近乎透明，衬得五官格外清晰。

眉毛生得浓淡适中，眉峰不高，微微向外舒展，天然带着几分疏离。最出彩的是那双桃花眼，眼型狭长，眼尾自然上扬，眼睫浓密而修长，低垂时像覆着一层浅浅的阴影；抬眼时，眼神又清透得近乎无辜，冷与柔同时存在，让人猜不透情绪。

左眼眼尾下方点着一颗极小的红痣，颜色像一滴未干的朱砂。它并不张扬，却恰好成为整张脸最鲜明的记忆点，让原本干净的气质里多出一点若有若无的艳色。很多人与他擦肩而过后，未必记得五官，却总会记得那颗红痣。

鼻梁线条流畅，鼻尖微圆，没有攻击性。嘴唇偏薄，却生得饱满，唇色很浅，不笑时显得淡漠，轻轻扬起嘴角时，又会冲淡所有距离感。

他的头发留得很长，墨黑而柔顺，平日随意扎成低马尾，额前散落几缕碎发。风吹过时，总有发丝轻轻扫过眼尾，反而让那双眼显得更加朦胧。

身形修长，高挑清瘦，肩背舒展，举止安静。无论穿着极简的黑色西装、宽松针织衫，还是普通白衬衫，都有一种不刻意却格外高级的质感。他不属于锋芒毕露的俊美，而是越看越容易陷进去的类型，像一幅色调克制的油画，需要驻足良久，才能发现其中细密的情绪。

items.title: 3D女性
items.prompt:
H&M "STYLE FOR EVERY VERSION" Ultra-Premium Fashion SMM Promotional Poster, Vertical 4:5, Instagram Hero Campaign, Global Fashion Advertising, Commercial Fashion Graphic Design, Youth Culture Marketing, Agency-Level Art Direction, Behance Front Page Quality, 8K UHD, Hyper-Realistic, Fashion × Graphic Design Fusion, social-first advertising, energetic commercial design, identity-driven storytelling, H&M sells possibility rather than clothing, one collection expressing multiple personalities, campaign built around individuality, self-expression, confidence, versatility and personal style.

The entire composition feels like multiple social media posts colliding together into one high-impact visual system, dynamic layered collage aesthetic, modern youth-culture advertising, oversized typography integrated into photography, overlapping design elements, disruptive layouts, editorial cutouts, digital-native graphic design language, movement and energy throughout the frame, inspired by Spotify Wrapped, Nike youth campaigns, Pinterest trend reports, magazine covers and modern social media design systems.

Four distinct H&M personalities occupy different zones of the composition. Look 01: Streetwear girl wearing oversized denim jacket, baggy cargo pants, white sneakers, confident stance, urban energy, trend-driven styling. Look 02: Minimalist woman wearing monochrome tailoring, clean silhouette, effortless sophistication, modern confidence, understated styling. Look 03: Creative male wearing layered overshirt, relaxed trousers, street-inspired fashion, artistic energy, contemporary styling. Look 04: Weekend casual look featuring graphic tee, denim, lightweight jacket, relaxed attitude, approachable confidence. All characters represent different versions of the same generation, demonstrating multiple identities within one H&M collection.

items.title: 同一人脸十二款发型 Lookbook
items.prompt:
Create a 12-panel grid (3 columns × 4 rows, numbered 1 to 12) showing the SAME person from the reference photo with 12 different hairstyles. This is a hairstyle lookbook. Final image aspect ratio: 4:5 (vertical/portrait).
THE ONLY THING THAT CHANGES BETWEEN PANELS IS THE HAIR ON THE HEAD (shape, style and length only). Everything else stays exactly as in the reference photo.
Identity Anchor (Critical)
The face must be IDENTICAL to the reference photo in every single panel. Preserve exactly: facial bone structure, jawline, cheekbones, nose shape, lips, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, skin tone, skin texture (pores, natural imperfections), and overall facial proportions. This is the same real person in all 12 frames. Do NOT beautify, slim, or alter the face. Same age, same expression as in the reference.
Mandatory Rules (Do Not Violate)
- NO SUNGLASSES. Eyes must be fully visible in all 12 panels.
- NO ENVIRONMENTAL BACKGROUNDS. Every panel must have a plain, uniform, solid light grey studio backdrop with zero objects, zero textures, zero gradients. Just flat neutral grey.
- Hair COLOR stays exactly as it appears in the reference photo in all 12 panels. Only the shape, length and style changes, never the color.
Keep Identical in Every Panel (Do Not Change)
- MAKEUP AND SKIN: If the person in the reference photo wears makeup, replicate it identically in every panel. Same lip color, same eye makeup, same brow grooming. If they wear no makeup, keep all panels makeup-free. Do NOT add, remove, or alter makeup between panels.
- Clothing: the same clothing visible in the reference photo, replicated exactly.
- Accessories: preserve ALL visible accessories from the reference photo (earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, piercings, watch, glasses, etc.). Do not omit, resize, recolor, or restyle any accessory. If the person wears prescription glasses (not sunglasses), keep them in every panel.
- Background: plain solid light grey studio backdrop in every panel. No room, no furniture, no environment.
The 12 Hairstyles
1. Pixie cut: very short, textured, slightly tousled on top with tapered sides and nape
2. Classic bob: chin-length, straight, blunt ends, clean middle part
3. Long layered waves: past the shoulders, soft voluminous waves with face-framing layers
4. Sleek low bun: hair pulled back smoothly into a tight low bun at the nape, no flyaways
5. Curtain bangs with medium-length hair: soft parted fringe framing the face, hair falling just past the shoulders
6. High ponytail: hair pulled up into a sleek high ponytail, smooth crown, length falling behind
7. French bob: short bob ending at the jawline with a soft blunt micro-fringe across the forehead
8. Long straight hair with middle part: very long, sleek, pin-straight, falling well past the shoulders
9. Shaggy wolf cut: medium length, heavy layers, choppy fringe, textured and voluminous with a slightly wild look
10. Elegant updo: hair swept up into a polished chignon with soft face-framing tendrils
11. Short curly crop: short voluminous curls all over, natural texture, tapered at the sides
12. Side-swept Hollywood waves: long glamorous deep side part, sculpted vintage waves cascading over one shoulder
Photographic Specs
Shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, studio portrait lighting (soft key light, subtle fill), shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the face. PLAIN SOLID LIGHT GREY STUDIO BACKGROUND in every panel. Natural skin rendering with visible pores and realistic hair strands (no plastic or CGI look). Consistent lighting, color grading and exposure across all 12 panels. Photorealistic, high detail, hyperrealistic, 8K. No illustration, no painterly effect, no over-smoothing. NO SUNGLASSES.
Each panel clearly numbered 1 to 12 in the top-left corner. Overall output aspect ratio 4:5.

items.title: 实拍背景涂鸦人物替换
items.promptZh:
仅将上传照片中的人物转换为可爱的手绘涂鸦人物，同时保持原始照片背景不变。

核心规则：
背景=原始的真实照片。
人=可爱的手绘涂鸦人物。

保留背景：
保持原始的天空、风景、建筑物、水、家具、地面、植物、栏杆、物体、灯光、颜色、透视、拍摄角度、取景和纹理尽可能接近原始照片。

请勿对背景或环境对象重新绘制、简化、说明或应用涂鸦/蜡笔/铅笔效果。

只改变人：
用迷人、天真的涂鸦版本替换每个人，同时保留：
- 确切人数
- 原始位置和相对比例
- 正面/背面/侧面/四分之三方向
- 头部和身体方向
- 姿势和手势
- 手臂和腿部的位置
- 与人或物体的互动
- 发型、服装颜色和主要配饰

重要：
如果有人背向一侧，请让他们背对着。
如果侧向，请将它们保持侧向。
如果面向前方，请保持向前。
切勿将人物转向观看者或捏造一张不可见的面孔。

可爱的涂鸦风格：
自由地将现实的解剖结构重新诠释成一个可爱的、不完美的角色：
- 超大圆头
- 小巧紧凑的机身
- 简化的短手臂和腿
- 小手小脚
- 可爱尴尬的比例
- 松散的潦草头发
- 可见的小圆点眼睛和简单的面部特征
- 适当时在脸颊上涂上红润的潦草图案

保持原来的姿势可识别，但为了可爱而简化并稍微夸张。

绘画风格：
宽松天真的手绘涂鸦，就像一幅快速的儿童素描。
使用细长的、不稳定的黑色轮廓、不完美的形状、重叠的草图线、潦草的彩色铅笔或蜡笔填充、不均匀的颜色、白色间隙和稍微凌乱的边缘。

这个角色看起来应该是故意画得很粗糙，但又非常可爱。

对象：
物体、家具、风景和人们周围的物品应尽可能保持照片清晰。涂鸦角色可能会自然地触摸或握住真实的摄影对象。

整合：
保持正确的比例、地面接触、深度和遮挡，以便涂鸦角色自然地占据与原始人物相同的位置。

最终外观：
感觉应该是真实的人物被从原始照片中删除，并被可爱的手绘涂鸦版本所取代，而现实世界的背景保持不变。

优先考虑：
1. 原始摄影背景
2.人物位置和比例
3. 准确的身体方向
4. 姿势和手势
5.可爱夸张的涂鸦人物设计

避免全图插图、背景涂鸦、逼真的解剖学、动画、漫画、3D 卡通、精美的数字艺术、矢量线、改变姿势、改变方向、添加人物或发明面孔。
items.prompt:
Transform ONLY the people in the uploaded photo into adorable hand-drawn doodle characters while keeping the original photographic background unchanged.

CORE RULE:
Background = original realistic photo.
People = cute hand-drawn doodle characters.

PRESERVE THE BACKGROUND:
Keep the original sky, landscape, buildings, water, furniture, ground, plants, railings, objects, lighting, colors, perspective, camera angle, framing, and textures as close to the original photo as possible.

Do NOT redraw, simplify, illustrate, or apply doodle/crayon/pencil effects to the background or environmental objects.

TRANSFORM ONLY PEOPLE:
Replace each person with a charming, naive doodle version while preserving:
- exact number of people
- original position and relative scale
- front/back/side/three-quarter orientation
- head and body direction
- pose and gesture
- arm and leg positions
- interactions with people or objects
- hairstyle, clothing colors, and major accessories

IMPORTANT:
If someone faces away, keep them back-facing.
If sideways, keep them sideways.
If facing forward, keep them forward.
Never rotate a person toward the viewer or invent a face that is not visible.

CUTE DOODLE STYLE:
Freely reinterpret realistic anatomy into an adorable, imperfect character:
- oversized round head
- tiny compact body
- short simplified arms and legs
- tiny hands and feet
- cute awkward proportions
- loose scribbled hair
- tiny dot eyes and simple facial features when visible
- rosy scribbled cheeks when appropriate

Keep the original pose recognizable, but simplify and slightly exaggerate it for cuteness.

DRAWING STYLE:
Loose naive hand-drawn doodle, like a quick children's sketch.
Use thin shaky black outlines, imperfect shapes, overlapping sketch lines, scribbled colored-pencil or crayon fills, uneven coloring, white gaps, and slightly messy edges.

The character should look intentionally roughly drawn but extremely cute.

OBJECTS:
Objects, furniture, scenery, and items around the people should remain photographic whenever possible. A doodle character may naturally touch or hold a real photographic object.

INTEGRATION:
Keep correct scale, ground contact, depth, and occlusion so the doodle characters naturally occupy the same locations as the original people.

FINAL LOOK:
It should feel like the real people were removed from the original photograph and replaced with adorable little hand-drawn doodle versions of themselves, while the real-world background remained untouched.

Prioritize:
1. Original photographic background
2. Person position and scale
3. Exact body orientation
4. Pose and gesture
5. Cute exaggerated doodle character design

Avoid full-image illustration, background doodling, realistic anatomy, anime, manga, 3D cartoon, polished digital art, vector lines, changed poses, changed orientation, added people, or invented faces.

items.title: 黑桃国王递归扑克牌
items.promptZh:
使用我上传的面部图像作为主要身份参考。以极高的保真度保留我准确的面部特征：相同的面部结构、下巴、颧骨、眼睛形状、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、胡须图案、发型、发质、肤色、皮肤纹理和整体可识别的外观。不要美化、改变或重新诠释我的脸。保持真实的解剖结构和真实的相似性。

创建超详细、电影般、超现实的豪华扑克牌艺术品。

主要主题是我作为黑桃K，占据了一张华丽的、皇家Ace品质的扑克牌的完整设计。我穿着精致的黑色和银色黑桃主题服饰、黑曜石和抛光钢锻造的王冠、精致的刺绣盔甲，以及饰有微妙黑桃符号的飘逸皇家服装。我的表情平静、聪明、有力。

我的右手拿着一张原始的黑桃 A 牌。

创意转折：我手里拿着的黑桃 A 不是一张普通的牌。它包含另一个完整的扑克牌插图。在那张牌中，我再次以黑桃 K 的身份出现，而整张牌正优雅地握在一位威严的红心皇后的手指之间。女王优雅、高贵、视觉冲击力十足，身着饰有心形图案的深红色和金色皇家服装。

这种错觉继续以微妙的递归故事讲述：红心皇后似乎正在着迷地审视这张牌，创造出“牌中牌”的视觉悖论。这部作品应该感觉像是一个权力、策略、爱情和命运交织在一起的传奇故事。

添加不可能的埃舍尔风格视觉设计元素：
•无限递归效果
•卡牌世界自行折叠
•漂浮的铲子和心形符号转变成乌鸦和玫瑰花瓣
•华丽的金色边框延伸到卡的物理边缘之外
•悬浮在半空中的皇家棋子
•隐藏在卡片雕刻中的分形图案
•优雅的烟雾形成西装符号
•从卡角出现的维度传送门

风格：超现实的奇幻现实主义与豪华赌场艺术、文艺复兴时期的皇家肖像画和现代电影概念艺术相结合。

灯光：戏剧性的明暗对比、立体的神光、丰富的对比度、发光的金属亮点、黑桃 A 周围微妙的魔法能量。

调色板：
•深黑色
•镀银
•象牙白
•深红色
•古色古香的金色配饰

成分：
•垂直杰作
•博物馆品质的细节
•超现实的纹理
•复杂的卡片雕刻
•完美对称的扑克牌美学与电影深度融为一体
• 焦点集中在我的脸上
•极高的身份保真度
•通过视觉象征讲述史诗般的故事

最终的图像应该感觉像是一款传奇奇幻纸牌游戏的封面，其中黑桃国王已经有了自我意识，存在于现实的多层中，同时被掌握在以红心皇后为代表的命运本身手中。

items.title: ROGUE VIPER 游戏概念设定板
items.prompt:
**ROGUE VIPER — VIDEO GAME CONCEPT ART SHEET PROMPT**

---

Official AAA video game concept art sheet titled **'ROGUE VIPER'** for an Unreal Engine 5 third-person action-stealth game. Professional game development documentation layout on a dark charcoal #1A1A1A background with gold stencil label typography throughout. Four clearly labeled panels arranged in a 2×2 grid with a header and footer.

---

**SHEET HEADER** — Bold gold stencil font title text: **ROGUE VIPER** centered at top. Subtitle beneath in smaller tracking-heavy label font: **CHARACTER & ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT SHEET | UNREAL ENGINE 5 | ACTION / STEALTH — THIRD PERSON**

---

**PANEL 1 — TOP LEFT — Label: "PROTAGONIST: MEI LIU / ROGUE VIPER"**

Full-body character turntable reference of a 30-year-old East Asian Chinese-American female operative. Athletic and toned, 5'8", long straight black hair worn loose, calm neutral expression with sharp eyes. Wearing a form-fitting matte black tactical bodysuit with gold accent seams running along the shoulders, forearms, and thighs, gold cobra snake belt buckle at the waist, calf-high black tactical boots with subtle gold trim. Armed with twin suppressed 9mm pistols holstered on each hip with custom viper-scale grip texture, a serrated combat knife sheathed vertically on the right thigh, and a compact pneumatic grappling hook launcher mounted on the left forearm. Three views arranged side-by-side: front, 3/4, and back. Unreal Engine 5 physically-based rendering, photorealistic skin and fabric materials, neutral 3-point studio lighting for maximum clarity, gold and matte black color scheme throughout.

---

**PANEL 2 — TOP RIGHT — Label: "ENEMY TYPE 01: OBSIDIAN PROTOCOL ENFORCER"**

Three enemy soldiers shown as character references against a dark background. These are elite private military contractors working for a shadow arms cartel called Obsidian Protocol. Their uniform: slate-gray and black modular plate carriers with deep crimson geometric hex-patch insignia on the shoulder, full-face ballistic visors with a dark red tinted lens, black tactical gloves, reinforced combat boots. Armed with compact bullpup assault rifles with red laser sights. One figure standing in neutral patrol stance, one crouched in a ready alert position, one depicted mid-aim with rifle raised. All three shown at the same scale for comparison. Same UE5 photorealistic PBR render style. Crimson and slate-gray color language to contrast Viper's gold and black.

---

**PANEL 3 — BOTTOM LEFT — Label: "STEALTH ENVIRONMENT: OBSIDIAN PROTOCOL BLACK SITE — ALPINE RESEARCH FACILITY"**

Wide cinematic establishing shot of a stealth mission environment. A hidden high-altitude research facility buried inside a snow-covered mountain, accessible only via an underground tram. Interior architecture is brutalist concrete and frosted glass, dimly lit with cold white fluorescent overhead strips and amber emergency lighting casting long dramatic shadows across polished concrete floors. Rows of classified server terminals and cryogenic storage units line the walls. Ventilation shafts visible in the ceiling above catwalks. A security camera sweeps a slow arc over a central corridor below. In the foreground, Rogue Viper is pressed flat against a concrete pillar in deep shadow, body low, watching two Obsidian Protocol enforcers on patrol below, one holding a flashlight. The scene communicates tension, patience, and tactical opportunity. Unreal Engine 5 Lumen global illumination, volumetric cold air haze, photorealistic ice and concrete materials, deep crushed blacks with cold white and amber lighting contrast. Cinematic wide 2.39:1 style composition within the panel.

---

**PANEL 4 — BOTTOM RIGHT — Label: "ACTION SET PIECE: OBSIDIAN PROTOCOL FREIGHT DEPOT — COLLAPSED BRIDGE CANYON"**

Wide cinematic action shot of a high-octane firefight environment. A sprawling open-air industrial freight depot at the edge of a sheer cliff canyon at dusk, with a collapsed suspension bridge dangling over the chasm below. Shipping containers and heavy crane equipment provide cover geometry. Rogue Viper is captured mid-movement in a dynamic gunfight pose — body low, both suppressed pistols raised and firing, muzzle flashes illuminating her face with sharp white light. Three Obsidian Protocol enforcers are positioned around her — one diving behind a container, one firing from atop a crane platform, one falling backward off the edge of the depot platform. Background: deep canyon with a river of orange reflected sunset light far below, dust and smoke rising from the firefight, a military helicopter approaching in the far distance. Warm dusk amber and cool canyon shadow blue provide dramatic color contrast. UE5 ray-traced reflections on metal container surfaces, particle systems for dust and muzzle smoke, cinematic depth of field on background elements.

---

**SHEET FOOTER** — Color palette chip row along the bottom of the sheet: matte black #1A1A1A, dark charcoal #2B2B2B, viper gold #D4AF37, gunmetal #3E3E3E, obsidian crimson #8B1A1A, slate gray #6B7280, cold white #E8EEF4. Label above chips: **COLOR PALETTE**. Footer text beneath: **ACTION / STEALTH — THIRD PERSON — UNREAL ENGINE 5 — © ROGUE VIPER GAME STUDIOS**

---

**UNIVERSAL STYLE CONSTRAINTS — APPLY TO ALL PANELS:**
Photorealistic only throughout the entire sheet. No anime, no cartoon, no stylized illustration, no cel shading, no comic book rendering. Unreal Engine 5 cinematic render quality with physically-based materials. Anamorphic lens character on all environment shots. Crushed blacks and desaturated mid-tones across all panels. Professional AAA game studio concept documentation format comparable to Naughty Dog, Ubisoft, or Guerrilla Games internal production art.

items.title: Earth Signs 角色 Scrapbook
items.promptZh:
使用提供的女性主题作为唯一参考创建新图像。零改动地保留她准确的面部特征、身份和特征。

主要科目——土元素
她代表了土元素的整体：脚踏实地、优雅、感性、平静、稳定、耐心、安静的力量和自然的奢华。放松的接地姿势，站立或坐着，柔软自然的手部放置，沉稳的女性肢体语言，扎根的存在。

服装
单一有凝聚力的地球风格编辑外观，采用橄榄色、鼠尾草色、灰褐色、摩卡色、米色、粘土色、奶油色、苔藓色和温暖的中性色。柔软结构的优雅廓形，精致的剪裁、垂坠、纹理对比或分层结构。面料：亚麻、棉质、哑光缎面、针织、仿麂皮纹理、柔软剪裁。简约的精制金色或自然色调配饰。

头发
柔和的灰棕色，具有自然的尺寸。健康、抛光、柔和丰盈的波浪或光滑的波浪，带有微妙的光泽，可控的纹理，修饰脸型的发丝，接地气和奢华的感觉。

彩妆
韩国柔光底色，带有泥土色调。温暖的米色、玫瑰色、赤土色、黄褐色或裸桃色腮红。眼睛颜色有灰褐色、摩卡色、焦糖色、淡青铜色、橄榄棕色。柔软眼线、香槟米色高光、缎面或天鹅绒裸色/摩卡唇色。整体抛光、感性、安静、奢华的美感。

环境
接地气的社论 地球风格的环境，包括石头、木材、亚麻、植物、干植物、天然织物、乡村奢华的造型、温暖的日光或漫射的社论灯光、柔和的阴影、宁静的电影般的静止。调色板：奶油色、橄榄色、苔藓色、粘土色、灰褐色、米色、柔和的绿色、暖棕色。

赤壁迷你系统
在她周围放置多个具有相同脸部、头发和身份的中型逼真 3D 赤壁迷你版。高端的娃娃造型，超大的头部，娇小的身体，闪亮的眼睛，逼真的头发，细致的妆容，微型时尚服装，柔和的电影3D灯光。

土象星座赤壁
金牛座——感性柔软奢华浪漫造型，针织或优雅女性化中性装束，丰富质感，金色点缀。超长分段双低马尾辫，白色织物带绑在框架周围，引人注目。
处女座——精致的完美主义美学，搭配精致的简约剪裁、简洁的线条、结构感十足的迷你连衣裙或精致的协调造型。
摩羯座——时尚的权力着装，搭配西装外套或定制套装，轮廓鲜明，低调奢华。将头发编成超长的雕塑辫子，包裹着金链和金属饰品。

涂鸦+剪贴簿覆盖
手绘泥土剪贴簿涂鸦：树叶、藤蔓、花朵、树枝、蘑菇、蝴蝶、星星、火花、石头、心、太阳涂鸦、植物图标。舒适的墨水笔纹理。

手写文字：
“地球标志”
“接地气、发光”
“软实力”
“植根于美”
“安静的奢华”
“稳定的能量”
“冷静的力量”
“天然磁性”

事实泡沫：
“元素：土”
“星座：金牛座、处女座、摩羯座”
“特质：脚踏实地、忠诚、优雅”
“能源：稳定、精致、可靠”

成分
主要主题集中并占主导地位。赤壁动态地放置在肩膀、手、侧面和下框架周围。涂鸦像剪贴簿一样自然地分层。平衡、富有表现力、优质的构图。

风格
电影编辑生活方式图像，时尚与插图的混合，高细节，锐利的焦点，温暖的中性色调，微妙的现实主义颗粒，逼真的人体渲染与风格化的 3D 赤壁和手绘覆盖。社交媒体就绪的优质美学。

相机
与眼睛齐平或略高于眼睛，中等全身或 3/4 取景，35 毫米或 50 毫米生活方式肖像外观，清晰的细节与柔和的大气深度。
